row.name: Planet-A
row.detailed_description: Welcome, to Planet A. Planet A is a ‘purposeful Metaverse’ which is focused on creating deeper knowledge, enjoyment and experience of the landmark real-world places Lendlease Podium is entrusted to create, and curate. Inside Planet A, anyone can virtually play, orientate and get-to-know quasi-physical places - and each other when multiplayer mode is initiated [coming mid-2022], before or after the real-world version has been constructed. Planet A is a mirror-world, a living city that reflects the realities and impacts of climate change that we face worldwide - most especially in our urban environments. Carbon Calculator data is your window into this. Inside this ‘Metaverse’, we educate through gamification day one, and will collaborate as the platform evolves, as players learn-about the most sustainable solutions to the greatest challenges humankind faces, today. We invite you to bring your energy, drive and the passion to embrace sustainability and make a difference. To begin, fly-into our first Planet A project: The Milano Innovation District (MIND) where you will meet your Planet A Chaperone. Formerly the site of the 2015 World Expo, your task is to play games that teach sustainability concepts such as waste management and IoT, battle the scoreboard and acquire all the skills and knowledge that are needed to plan and manifest a net-zero urban-regeneration project, like a ‘Lendlease Podium Pro’. And your rewards won’t just be virtual. Online Planet-A Scoreboard leaders will literally make their mark on MIND, being projected and celebrated in-and-on the real-world site. Plus….. from time to time, you never know what your game-points might be 'unlock' - in the real-world…. Join us on a journey into Planet A. Join our initiative to virtually + physically build a world that gives more than it takes. And - take your pick of experiencing in PC or in tethered VR.
row.short_description: Planet A is a purposeful Metaverse. A geo-spatially correct Digital Twin that has been created created for gameplay and education, and getting to know places that may or may not-yet exist in the real world. This is just the beginning - start your journey.

row.name: Artistic Girl 1
row.detailed_description: Click on the dlc to get 40% off the bundle Introduction Artistic Girl 1 is a puzzle game where you just need to swap bricks to make the image back There is no time or star limit in the game, the intention is to let you enjoy a relaxed experience Features There are moving pictures after image restoration Gallery can be operated with one hand 100 collectible achievements
row.short_description: Relaxing puzzle game, artistic photo beauty, let you have a good mood Click on the dlc to get 40% off the bundle
row.notes: - Nudity or pornographic content - Not suitable for viewing at work - Content not suitable for all ages - The characters in the game are all over 18 years old

row.name: Car War Legends
row.detailed_description: {steam_app_image}/extras/title_chain.png car War Legends Overcome dangerous obstacles, Battle against other drivers, and Race to the death in this intense car racing game! Do you have what it takes to survive and win? Push your ride to its limits and reign supreme as CAR WAR LEGEND! ● Destroy Your competitors Battle against other drivers to death and destruction! ● Race to victory Push your accelerator and race to the finish line! ● Build a killer vehicle Earn points after every win and upgrade your vehicle! Use your points to get superior armor, weapons, and engine for your machine. ● High-quality graphics and smooth gameplay Designed for a high-intensity playing experience!
row.short_description: Overcome dangerous obstacles, Battle against other drivers, and Race to the death in this intense car racing game!

row.name: Chrysalis Inc.
row.detailed_description: Chrysalis Inc. is a 2D 3D Horror Adventure Puzzle Side Scroller. Explore the abandoned toy factory, solve intricate puzzles and unveil the deep dark truth behind it. Story: Waking up in an abandoned toy factory, You realize something is not right. The area is filled with weird machinery and strange imagery. Slipping between the past and present, you need to puzzle your way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear. As you delve into the depths of the factory, the layered truth will begin to unravel with each horrifying discovery. From the vicious robots left to rot, to the unexplainable residual power that grants time travel, not everything is what it seems. Maybe some truths are best left buried. Features & Mechanics: Dark, Depressing Irony: They say that the road to hell is paved with good intentions. One act of goodwill for one person could cause the suffering of many. One child’s glee at receiving the latest toy overshadows the tiny, grimy hands that constructed it. Explore a ruined factory: Traverse through the vast yet lifeless factory, where your only company will hunt you down. With each new location, the story behind the factory's construction and creations will be revealed in fragmented pieces. Unique Puzzles: Through innovative puzzles, you will be able to change the past to affect the present. Use this ability well to help you solve the mystery. This game is a student project developed over 9 months by 9 students in the Entertainment Arts and Engineering (EAE) Graduate Program at the University of Utah.
row.short_description: Slipping between the past and present, a child puzzles their way through a crumbling toy factory filled with the remnants of its child workers and the grudges they bear.

row.name: Coral Cove
row.detailed_description: Azure waters, vibrant corals and busy flocks of fish are what used to await you a few meters under the water surface. But the damages of pollution have extinguished most of this. With only a few corals left, it is up to you to restore the once beautiful ecosystems in this relaxing match 3-like game. But beware of the dangers lingering underwater and your slowly depleting stock of corals. You start with nothing but a few tiles to build on and a small hand of coral cards to place. Three corals of the same level merge into a new coral of the next higher level. Through clever planning and strategic placement your corals will soon expand into a large, lively reef. Explore the seafloor to find new challenges, quests and special structures to help you with your run. Expand your reef to unlock different areas and advance to new places. But watch out for the dangers you and your coral reef will have to face. Short rounds, numerous hindrances to overcome and always new strategies to build and advance encourage replaying again and again. The expanses of Coral Cove await you!
row.short_description: Coral Cove is a relaxing match 3-like underwater game in which you try to build the largest reef without running out of corals to place.

row.name: SOUL JANITOR
row.detailed_description: In SOUL JANITOR you play as a janitor who was contracted into cleaning out an old thought to be abandoned warehouse. You quickly find out that there is much more to this warehouse than a few dirty bathrooms. Armed with only your spray bottle, you must fight your way through the warehouse to complete your contract and unravel the mysteries of the facility along the way. Key Features: - Explore a detailed environment - Fight unique spirit enemies - Solve puzzles and find tapes to unravel the mystery
row.short_description: In SOUL JANITOR you play as a worker contracted into a night time janitorial job, but when you arrive you find out that your cleaning up more than just toliets. Armed with only your spray bottle fight your way through the facilities in order to complete your contract and escape the facility!

row.name: Pickle Clicker
row.detailed_description: IMPORTANT NOTE: This game doesn't have any sort of ascension/rebirth at the moment and development for this game is unfortunately going to be on and off. Welcome to Pickle Clicker, an incremental game based on pickles. You just click the pickle and get a pickle out of thin air. Not only that, but with your pickles you have the ability to purchase and further enhance your pickle picking empire by buying auto pickles. But watch out! The more pickles you have, the more Poglins eager to come and steal your pickles, so defend and fight back with the purchasing of upgrade pickles.
row.short_description: Click pickle, get pickle, spend pickle, get more pickle, and most importantly... Protect pickle from sneaky Poglins!

row.name: STUG
row.detailed_description: Battle other players in tanks inspired by iconic fighting vehicles including heavy tanks, half-tracks, and armored cars. Use special abilities like grenades and airstrikes to gain the upper hand and dominate your opponents. Personalize your tank! Flex your skills by unlocking camouflage patterns, and go to the Shop to customize your vehicle with unique stickers and decals. STUG is always evolving with rotating gamemodes, new maps, and new vehicles. Play now!
row.short_description: STUG is a free multiplayer physics based tank combat game where every shot counts. Angle your armor to bounce incoming fire, and ricochet shots off walls to hit enemies in their weak points.

row.name: StereoPaint
row.detailed_description: StereoPaint is a VR 3d sculpting app that uses paint style interactions to create colorful voxelized models in real time. It allows the fluid and intuitive sculpting and manipulation of 3d models using various tools and volumetric brush shapes. In addition, StereoPaint provides various environments using reactive real time simulated physics to interact with your model.
row.short_description: StereoPaint is a VR 3d sculpting app that uses paint style interactions to create colorful voxelized models in real time. Manipulate virtual material as if it were clay using additive, subtractive or soft matter action.

row.name: 飛天歷險國際中文版(Dream Of Mirror Online)
row.detailed_description: 故事背景 　　崑崙鏡，記載著現實世界中所有一切的上古神器，鏡中世界中亦存在著一個映射現實的世界，而這個世界則是由十二位鏡王共同掌管。 　　不知從何時開始，崑崙鏡世界已經無法完全映射現實，多位鏡王也失去了蹤影，在查明原因為現實世界的人類所製造的「妄想」被映射到崑崙鏡中，「妄想」變成生命且四處干擾崑崙鏡後，鏡王們便開始計劃召喚現實世界中的人們來到鏡中世界，處理這一切的紛紛擾擾……。 遊戲特色 ．自由轉職系統 職業間的轉換不再有重重限制，亦無需要新創或重建角色，只要這個職業是你想玩的，完成轉職任務後，隨時都能找轉職仙人轉換職業。 ．附掛天賦，變化多端的組合 透過附掛天賦，即使是刀客也能補血，道士也能耍大刀，只要你想得出來，要怎麼搭配就能怎麼搭配，練的職業技能越多，組合也就越多越自由，玩法也越豐富。 ．豐富的劇情內容 主線劇情不再單一，有著與人類共同奮鬥的「善」主線，以及與妖魔為伍的「惡」主線，讓你不再只能選擇當個大俠。除了大時代淒美的主線劇情，還有許多輕鬆的小品故事。 ．專業的運鏡手法，電影般的劇情呈現 劇情任務不再只是單純的對話，以如同電影般的「第三人稱」視角，專業流暢的運鏡手法搭配劇情上的互動，可體驗到彷彿置身於電影院般的全新感受。 ．參考傳統黃曆的命運設定 在建立角色時提供的生日與生肖，會根據中國黃曆設計的系統計算建立自己的命格，而在遊戲中會發現許多人與自己的命格有些特別的關係──宿親、宿敵與真愛，每個關係都是一種緣分。 ．以可愛的卡通呈現傳統風味 覺得中國傳統的元素過於沉悶死板嗎？透過生動可愛的卡通貼圖模式呈現後，一切都變的平易近人，且隨時都能透過設定切換，讓你能依照心情隨時更換視覺上的呈現。 多樣的玩法選擇 ．生活性與故事性 《飛天歷險》擁有完整的生活機制規劃設計，並同時具備豐富的故事架構。在遊戲中，你可以扮演一個名聞遐邇的名人俠士，也可以扮演一名默默無名的市井小民；可以是闖蕩江湖的英雄豪傑，也可以是經營一方的萬元大戶。 ．打怪練功與生產煉化 角色的成長是遊戲中不可或缺的一環，在《飛天歷險》中，可以從事各式各樣的職業。擅於戰鬥的職業可透過打怪練功增加經驗值和提升等級，而戰鬥系職業可分為專司主動攻擊和負責補血、輔助攻擊。擅於生產的職業可透過採集和煉化增加金錢收入，生產系職業中亦可分為負責煉化武器、防具及道具與提供原料。 ．副本挑戰 除了打怪練功與生產煉化，亦有各式各樣的大、小型副本可挑戰，你可以當個獨行俠挑戰小型副本，亦可以與公會成員或三五好友組成隊伍一同挑戰大型副本。 ．每日活動 厭倦了一直打怪的生活嗎？在《飛天歷險》中，每天都有各式各樣的小活動，像是解放雙手的泡溫泉，眼明手快的飛拼不可等，許多趣味小遊戲等著你來參加。 ．個人主義與社群關係 在《飛天歷險》中，玩家可以成立公會認識各地英雄豪傑，也可以結成師徒、朋友與戀人等特殊關係；亦可以自立更生、特立獨行，隱性埋名做個獨行俠。
row.short_description: 《飛天歷險》是一款經典MMORPG，故事背景發生在「崑崙鏡」所創造的神器世界，由於崑崙鏡世界的秩序失恆，世界的管理者「鏡王」便召喚玩家前來幫忙。獨特的自由轉職系統與天賦搭配，「善」與「惡」主線劇情等，各種特色玩法等著您前來一探究竟！

row.name: 伏妖绘卷
row.detailed_description: 唐风仙侠MMOARPG游戏，带你置身野史志怪、和风唯美、神人共处的仙侠世界。 一步一景 古装唐风跟仙侠的完美融合，超然的世界场景，日式和风的建筑角色，总有不一样的享受。 山海志怪 怒火金乌，覆海后鬼，河伯冯夷……有山海经志异，也有百鬼夜行，日式物语，多神话共处。 其他示例 各场景风格各具差异，跟随等级主线，逐步开放，收集怪物图鉴。 宏大的神话世界地图，不夜城、青丘国、悬空寺……各类洞天福地可以自由探索。 全天在线的boss场景，有野外妖王、世界妖王、琥珀妖冢，有粉装、红装、橙装，随机掉落。 可自由单挑，可组队刷怪，也可帮派共享，单人、多人、全服都可以参与的玩法。 铭文天赋树，有限的槽位、不一样的各类属性搭配，玩出不一样的各类技能流派。
row.short_description: 唐风还是和风，野史还是仙侠，一款全新画风的仙侠游戏等你来体验。

row.name: VPet-Simulator
row.detailed_description: VPet is a desktop pet software(game) that supports various interactive. it is open source, free and support Steam workshops This game is independent from the built-in desktop pet (tutorial) program of VUP Simulator, if you like it, you can also add VUP Simulator to your wishlist Lots of interactions and animations More than 200 Type of Animation, Some Animation Examples : touch the head & Body bring up dance climb the wall See more image resources details in open source docs Free The game is completely free! The main purpose of the game is to promote the VUP-Simulator, This is the desktop pet inside the VUP Simulator. Open Source The game is open source on github, welcome to put forward your own ideas, ideas or participate in the development! You can also modify the code to make your own table pet! (Although most of the content supports the workshop, is no need to modify the code) project address: github-LorisYounger/VPet Support Steam Workshop The game supports the Steam Workshop, you can make animations or interactions with other characters and table pets, and upload them to the creative workshop to share with more people. The creative workshop supports adding/modifying the following content The creative workshop supports adding/modifying the following content Table pet animation Items/food/beverages, etc Table pet work Speech text Theme Code plugin - Add content to desktop pets by writing code Add new animation logic/display scheme (eg: l2d/spin, etc.) Add new features (alarm clock/dashboard, etc.) Almost omnipotent Feedback & Suggestions & Contact Us If you have any suggestions or comments, you can contact me in Steam store Comments/Community, Github Issue or email me
row.short_description: Feeling like the computer desktop is too dull? Need something cute to heal oneself? Come and try this new completely free and open source V-Pet simulator. A cute and adorable pet that supports various feeding interactions to accompany you in game learning is definitely your best choice!

row.name: Galaxy Splitter
row.detailed_description: Interstellar peace is at stake and only you can save it! Accept your mission as fighter pilot in Galaxy Splitter and free all the planets from hostile spaceships! This action game will beam you directly into a new galaxy with trigger-happy enemies and high-value cargo. Captain Smith will help start you on your galactic adventure. He’ll show you how to make your spaceship combat-ready with weapons and modules and what to collect on your missions. The galactic Action Game In this Vertical Shooter you will encounter a lot of enemies. Their spaceships are upgraded and the squadrons are ready to stop you on your mission. Beware of the projectiles and rockets – your protective shields won't last forever! Whether you will succeed in this action game highly depends on the right strategy. Choose an appropriate spaceship to liberate a planet: Will you choose the Fighter, the Interceptor or the Destroyer? All of them have completely different properties: speed, maneuverability, equipment capacity, and size of the cargo hold – there's the perfect spaceship for every mission! Also the right equipment will help you win: weapons – fire automatically modules – change / modify the values of weapons and spaceships special weapons – can be fired only once per mission but are particularly strong protective shield – resists enemy attacks A vertical shooter in front of epic 3D planets Your missions in Galaxy Splitter will lead you across a virtual galaxy with ever new challenges. Pick up your delivery and take on passengers. The opposing armada of spaceships will get in your way. Strike back with projectiles, rockets, and even stronger weapons! Also your ammunition has different characteristics: simple ammunition: causes damage on impact penetrating ammunition: shot continues flying after a hit splitting ammunition: project divides on impact into secondary projectiles explosion: causes damage in the whole region homing ammunition: follows its target and always finds its mark In case you're facing superior enemies, you can employ evasive maneuvers. When you get hit by the enemy, you can have your spaceship repaired in the Hangar. Let's start your interstellar combat mission with this action-packed Vertical Shooter – play Galaxy Splitter now!
row.short_description: Intergalactic combat with the vertical shooter

row.name: Splinters of Regret
row.detailed_description: Splinters of Regret is a student-made action game with a focus on bullet hell elements and an atmospheric aesthetic. After committing multiple sins in life, you are forced to face them in death. A mountainous prison made of your own regrets seeks to make sure you never forget them. Make your way through the regretful hordes and hazardous terrain to find a form of peace at the top. Splintering With the power of Splintering, you have a second chance at 'life' after the regrets overwhelm you. However, you are defenseless and must survive the onslaught to regain your control. Vulnerability is what your regrets want. Items and Artifacts Encounter a variety of items and artifacts to help you on your journey. Items provide one-use destruction against the regretful hordes that plague you. Artifacts are lasting equipment that gives you a source of protection and aid. The Language of Na'en Listen to the original language of Na'en that the inhabitants speak from across the void in their own personal regret-filled prisons. You can find our language document at this link: .
row.short_description: Splinters of Regret is an atmospheric, action bullet hell where you fight your way through manifestations of your regrets.

row.name: Alcohol Empire
row.detailed_description: Alcohol Empire - unusual mixture of real-time strategy and card game. Use a variety of cards and a range of buildings you can buy or build to gain an advantage and defeat your opponents! However, do not forget about time - the huge pace of the game will not allow you to think through your moves for a long time in advance, you will have to act quickly in order to keep up with your opponents. Game Features: Access to three characters with already prepared decks of cards. Let's skip the tedious part of deck building and jump right into the fight. We're here for fun! Buy buildings belonging to other players, steal cards from them, strengthen your buildings or weaken enemy ones - everyone can find a strategy for themselves. The high pace of the game will not let you get bored, and the victory will depend not only on the quality, but also on the speed of decision-making. The original visual and sound design gives the game a unique charm.
row.short_description: Alcohol Empire - unusual mixture of real-time strategy and card game. Use a variety of cards and a range of buildings you can buy or build to gain an advantage and defeat your opponents!

row.name: Zombie Death Quota
row.detailed_description: Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak and evacuate in the helicopter. Explore the island and find Bio-waste containers and neutralise enough Zombies to achieve the Zombie Death Quota. Scavenge for guns, ammo, grenades and health packs scattered around the island to help you in your mission. This first person shooter was first launched on the Xbox 360 Indie Games service in 2012, the XBLIG service was closed down in 2017. Play this part of gaming history which is preserved here today and support me by checking out my newest game Splodge Royale. Weapons Flamethrower: A Heavy Metal flamethrower. Shotgun: Never be without one in an apocalypse. Scoped Rifle: When you don’t want to move much. Pistol: Infinite ammo. Machine Gun: Short range, but very good when you are surrounded. Levels Play 13 increasingly difficult levels.
row.short_description: Help Special Forces operative Della retrieve the Bio-waste containers that are causing the zombie outbreak. Grenade, shotgun, snipe and flame your way through the zombie horde and then evacuate in the helicopter.
row.notes: Frequent Zombie head explosions with lots of blood. Burning Zombies. Slightly scary sounds and music.

row.name: GrumpyTunez
row.detailed_description: GrumpyTunez was designed for anyone to quickly tune a vehicle. This process can assist tuning a vehicle fast without prior knowledge of gear tuning. Grumpytunez runs as an overlay with supported games to analyze the telemetry data. Telemetry data out features are disabled by default. Features can be enabled via Settings/Hud and Gameplay menu of the game. Grumpytunez will analyze live output of telemetry data. Tune fast, Go fast! Features: Gear tuning Dyno chart Live RPM, HP, & TQ displays Suspension tuning Live Suspension display Customizable tuning and display panel layouts. Grumpytunez currently supports the following games: Forza Horizon 4 Forza Horizon 5 Forza Motorsport 7 (Windowed Mode)
row.short_description: GrumpyTunez was designed for quick tuning of vehicles so anyone could tune, race & go faster!

row.name: Conflict 3048
row.detailed_description: Conflict 3048 is a real time tactical sci fi game written by Matt Lloyd in 2022. CAMPAIGN You play as a commander in the invading army on an alien world, documenting your trials and tribulations as you wage war against the alien hordes. Your tour of duty begins in a small listening post near the front lines and soon has you fighting battles against hundreds of aliens in do or die actions. ARMY FEATURES At your disposal are infantry with assault rifles, flame throwers, heavy combat shotguns;mechs with laser rifles and flame throwers, medics with the latest in battlefield healing technology and also air support and artillery. Throw into the mix armoured personnel carriers that can fly to anywhere on the battlefield and you've got yourself a force worthy of eliminating the alien enemies. GAME EDITOR and SCRIPTING If you tire of the main campaign you can edit the missions with the editor with the touch of a button, or craft your own new campaigns with full scripting support. The scripting, editing and customisation ability is all documented. In fact the game even ships with source code if you wish to make further changes to the game mechanics. Switching between editing mode and play mode is seamless.
row.short_description: Real-time strategy and tactics on an alien world! Command super space soldiers against an array of alien hordes. Commander - we need you!

row.name: The Dream Team
row.detailed_description: The people of reality are falling into permanent slumber, never being able to wake up. With the help of the Dream Witch Poppy, Fruit, Rob, and Blue will enter the Dream Realm, a space where all dreams converge. There they will enter the dreams of their friends and try to wake them up from the inside. Join our heroes as they save many familiar faces within the Dream Realm. Return to reality to spend time with friends, record content, and gear up for your next adventure! The more people you save, the more you can weaken the gate at the end of the Dream Realm to get inside and strike down whoever or whatever is putting people into permanent sleep.
row.short_description: A fanmade game about Mr. Fruit and the Dream Team. A semi-linear turnbased RPG puzzle game where you play as Fruit, Rob, Blue, and Poppy to save reality from permanent sleep. Plenty of references, and a story deep enough to have things to spoil.

row.name: Leviathan
row.detailed_description: Leviathan is a multiplayer extraction shooter set in a sci-fi universe where humanity has been abducted by a gargantuan, interstellar beast and changed over the course of several millennia. The abducted were ultimately discarded onto foreign planets. To survive, they have been forced to evolved into three factions of biologically and ideologically distinct lifeforms. Recently, a second wave of abductions have occurred. Fate has brought them together to the surface of the bountiful world of Domusalus; where only ONE FACTION can establish dominance for their survival. Fight for control of Domusalus as one of these factions: • Terran – Strength is paramount. Given the chance to demonstrate their might to the weaker factions, they will surely establish dominance. Domusalus, being rich in natural resources their home planet is greatly lacking, shows itself as an opportunity to conquer. After previously living in such hostile environments, the Terran have no intentions of sharing this wealth – the other factions are merely an obstacle in their path to claim what is theirs. • Faunian – The Faunian believe in the preservation of natural life. If any being was to show disrespect to this order, that being is considered a pollutant that must be cleansed from the ecosystem. After seeing the other factions taking selfish advantage of the planet’s resources, the Faunian ready themselves to protect it, even if it means total extinction of the opposition, and the native Domi people. • Angel – With golden metallic bodies, the Angel have discarded their ties to humanity. In doing so, they have become virtually immortal and seek to 'upgrade' all other lifeforms in the same way. Believing that this is the only way for advancement, any who resist are marked at as primitive beings that require immediate extermination. Key Features • Three playable factions – each with a mysterious shared history! • Hundreds of items - weapons, ammo, armor, grenades, restoratives and more! • Explore the “Aurelian Wilds” - a HUGE map offering unique areas, enemies, loot and extractions! • High risk/High reward - fight against (and loot!) both AI and Player opponents! • Play solo or in teams of three – take the loot for yourself OR work together to enhance survivability! • Capture outposts – make your mark to boost your faction's domination over the planet!
row.short_description: Play as 1 of 3 factions in the fight for control of Domusalus, but beware the Kaecillian menace who threaten both locals and warring factions. Deploy with your gear, search for upgraded loot, and escape in time to keep it for your next assault for planetary dominance.

row.name: Psychosis
row.detailed_description: While investigating the home of a family gone missing, you find evidence of something unexplainable. But when you approach it, the world goes dark. You awaken drenched in blood and faced with the shattered skull of a gnarled unnatural creature. Darkness. You sprint through a forest beset by fog, sure only that you must run. Enter the world of Psychosis, a retro-style survival-horror game about psychology and the coldness of killing. SURVIVE AT ALL COSTS Wield deadly weapons to face the horrors of your own mind and save yourself from a never-ending hell. UNCOVER A MYSTERY Reassemble the disturbing shreds of evidence left behind by the missing family members and escape this dark world with your life. SUFFER THE SURREAL Trust nothing as your grasp on your own surroundings slips away in an ever-changing environment as you fight to maintain your own sanity. EXPERIENCE NOSTALGIA Transport yourself back to the 1990s Pacific Northwest with a hybrid-retro art style reminiscent of the era. The game is presented with low-res art, modern lighting, and crunchy audio.
row.short_description: Fight against demons and your own mind to save yourself from a never-ending hell in this retro-style survival-horror game about mystery, psychology, and the coldness of killing. Banish demons with deadly weapons and reassemble the mysterious pieces of a family gone missing in Psychosis.

row.name: xVATrainer
row.detailed_description: xVATrainer is the companion app to xVASynth, the AI text-to-speech app using video game voices. xVATrainer is used for creating the voice models for xVASynth, and for curating and pre-processing the datasets used for training these models. Check the nexusmods page description for more details, instructions, and updates. Join the Discord for support, and community advice. IMPORTANT : The 'priors' files NEED to be installed for v3 voice training to be possible. Don't forget to download and install these. This is synthetic data (+ some real data from the NVIDIA HIFI TTS and VCTK datasets) to maintain multi-lingual and voice range capabilities when fine-tuning individual voices, similar to Dreambooth training. Due to steam filesize uploads, these can be freely downloaded from the nexusmods xVATrainer page. Dataset annotation The main screen of xVATrainer contains a dataset explorer, which gives you an easy way to view, analyze, and adjust the data samples in your dataset. It further provides recording capabilities, if you need to record a dataset of your own voice, straight through the app, into the correct format. Trainer xVATrainer contains AI model training, for the FastPitch1.1 (with modified training set-up), and HiFi-GAN models (the xVASynth 'v2' models). The training follows a multi-stage approach especially optimized for maximum transfer learning (fine-tuning) quality. The generated models are exported into the correct format required by xVASynth, ready to use for generating audio with. Batch training is also supported, allowing you to queue up any number of datasets to train, with cross-session persistence. The training panel shows a cmd-like textual log of the training progress, a tensorboard-like visual graph for the most relevant metrics, and a task manager-like set of system resources graphs. Tools There are several data pre-processing tools included in xVATrainer, to help you with almost any data preparation work you may need to do, to prepare your datasets for training. There is no step-by-step order that they need to be operated in, so long as your datasets end up as 22050Hz mono wav files of clean speech audio, up to about 10 seconds in length, with an associated transcript file with each audio file's transcript. Depending on what sources your data is from, you can pick which tools you need to use, to prepare your dataset to match that format. The included tools are: Audio formatting - a tool to convert from most audio formats into the required 22050Hz mono .wav format AI speaker diarization - an AI model that automatically extracts short slices of speech audio from otherwise longer audio samples (including feature length movie sized audio clips). The audio slices are additionally separated automatically into different individual speakers AI source separation - an AI model that can remove background noise, music, and echo from an audio clip of speech Audio Normalization - a tool which normalizes (EBU R128) audio to standard loudness WEM to OGG - a tool to convert from a common audio format found in game files, to a playable .ogg format. Use the 'Audio formatting' tool to convert this to the required .wav format Cluster speakers - a tool which uses an AI model to encode audio files, and then clusters them into a known or unknown number of clusters, either separating multiple speakers, or single-speaker audio styles Speaker similarity search - a tool which encoders some query files, a larger corpus of audio files, and then re-orders the larger corpus according to each file's similarity to all the query files Speaker cluster similarity search - the same as the 'Speaker similarity search' tool, but using clusters calculated via the 'Cluster speakers' tool as data points in the corpus to sort Transcribe - an AI model which automatically generates a text transcript for audio files WER transcript evaluation - a tool which examines your dataset's transcript against one auto-generated via the 'Transcribe' tool to check for quality. Useful when supplying your own transcript, and checking if there are any transcription errors. Remove background noise - a more traditional noise removal tool, which uses a clip of just noise as reference to remove from a larger corpus of audio which consistently has matching background noise Silence Split - A simple tool which splits long audio clips based on configurable silence detection Special thanks: D0lphin, flyingvelociraptor, Caden Black, Max Loef, LadyVaudry, Thuggysmurf, radbeetle, TomahawkJackson, Solstice_, Bungles, midori95, eldayualien, John Detwiler, Cecell, Wandering Youth, ellia, Retlaw83, Trixie, CHASE MCKELVY, Leif, ionite, Joshua Jones, Jaktt1337, David Keith vun Kannon, Netherworks (Jo-Jo), neci, Rachel Wiles, Imogen, Deer, Linthar, sadfer, Danielle, Hector Medima, Sh1tMagnet, ReaperStoleMyStyle, AshbeeGaming, TCG, Lady Steel, Mikkel Jensen, CookieGalaxy, GrumpyBen, Adrilz, ReyVenom, dog, bourbonicRecluse, ShiningEdge, Dozen9292, manlethamlet, smokeandash, Elias V, EnculerDeTaMere, SKiLLsSoLoN, J, finalfrog, Hound740, Buck, Yael van Dok, ChrisTheStranger, Isabel, Fuzzy Lonesome, Drake, Beto, AceAvenger, bobbigmac, Alexandra Whitton, yic17, Joebobslim, ThatGuyWithaFace, Sergey Trifonov, Zensho, AgitoRivers, beccatoria, valo999, Ne0nFLaSH, Caro Tuts, Jack in the Hinter, Hammerhead96 ., Bewitched, Para, Wht??? row.name: Cards of the Dreaming Dragons
row.detailed_description: How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family and tests your understanding of how they think. In this world of fantasy, you must figure out what dreams other people had and accumulate more points than any other in order to win. This is an amazing experience with friends, because you want to figure out what they are thinking, all while trying to win. It’s a game of trust, but also of deceit and with its fair share of challenges. How do you play Cards of the Dreaming Dragons? Each turn, a player is assigned the role of the 'dreaming dragon'. The dreaming dragon selects a single card from their hand. This becomes their 'dream'. They will provide a phrase which describes their dream. Then each other player selects a card from their hand which best matches the phrase given by the dreaming dragon. Once all players have selected a card, each player (except the 'dreaming dragon') will guess the 'dream' from all the cards. How do you win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons? If all players correctly guess the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points. If no player correctly guesses the 'dream', then every player (except the 'dreaming dragon') scores 2 points. If at least 1 player, but not all players, correctly guess the dream, then the 'dreaming dragon' and any player which correctly guessed scores 3 points. If a player guesses a card that is not the 'dream', then the player who put down that card scores 1 point. Once all points are scored, this ends the turn and the next player takes the role of the 'dreaming dragon'. In order to win Cards of the Dreaming Dragons, you will need to reach the end of the game board first. Each point you receive will allow you to move upward on the game board. You are represented by a cute dragon on the board as you move through this fantasy world until the end, trying to win and surpass the enemies. Intense, exciting card game and board game experience Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is an exciting combination between a multiplayer board game, card game and fantasy tabletop. It’s also an immersive multiplayer game to play with the entire family or friends. It adds a lot of competition, fun, excitement and it also encourages you to strategize in order to win. Test out your skills, strategize and see if you have what it takes to defeat your friends and become the ultimate dragon!
row.short_description: How well do you know your friends? Cards of the Dreaming Dragons is the ultimate tabletop game you can play with your friends and family. Figure out what they are thinking and deceive them to win. Play with 3-8 players.

row.name: Battle of the Four Towers
row.detailed_description: Four Towers have long been at war. For centuries the leaders of the towers were unable to conclude their petty fighting. No matter how often they were attacked, a strong defence always matched it. Until history erased it. Events were rewritten and scrapped from books as people turned their battle into a ‘sport’. The rich would gamble their money as the poor only hoped to win the grand prize. Teams would enter and leave as enemies. Alliances between Towers were formed, only for friendships to end. The power of money convinced anyone. Gameplay Battle of the Four Towers is an online 1v1v1v1 game best played with friends. Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points (LP), but if they defend they lose nothing. Each action takes 1 LP, so plan accordingly. Battle of the Four Towers is in early access. Over the next few months, this game will feature many updates to add to its few features. At the moment, this game has the bare minimum. It is best to play games with your friends, but there are plans to continue development to add more features and fix bugs.
row.short_description: Take command of a tower as you battle 3 others in a game of strategy and wits. Each round, pick up to 3 actions, either attack another tower or defend from another tower. If you manage to attack a tower, then they lose 3 Life Points, but if they defend they lose nothing.

row.name: ANETHA
row.detailed_description: 딸을 찾고 있어? 그녀는 지금 내 옆에 있어. 네 딸을 지키고 싶다면 복종해. - ??? 비가 거칠게 내리는 날 밤이었습니다. 갑작스레 사라진 딸은 며칠째 돌아오지 않았고, 당신은 이혼 후 딸에게 신경을 써주지 못한 것 같아 초조하기만 합니다. 그 순간 핸드폰에 울린 알람은 기다리던 딸이 아닌, 낯선 남자의 협박과 정체불명의 파일 하나. 남자의 명령에 따라, 파일을 정확하게 풀어보세요. 당신이 몰랐던 딸의 행적이 수면 위로 떠오를 때까지. 사라진 딸을 구하기 위해 납치범이 건넨 파일을 푸세요. 지시를 따라, 실마리를 풀어갈수록 당신의 상상 속 따뜻한 꽃밭이 식어감을 느낄 것입니다. 생각보다 더 차가운 현실 속에서 당신에게 쥐어진 선택, 복수, 단죄, 마지막으로 부성까지. 과연 당신은 어떤 미래를 맞이하게 될까요? 현실을 반영하는 게임, 아네사 때로는 픽션보다 더 픽션 같은 현실이 세상을 배회합니다. 삶의 단면은 언제나 시리게 아프고, 내 안에 사는 괴물을 억눌러야만 하는 날들만이 이어집니다. 그리고 아네사의 시선은 언제나, 괴물의 선명한 눈동자를 응시합니다. 눈을 떼지 말고 지켜봐 주세요. 아네사가 제안하는 현실이, 조금 섬뜩할지라도. 당신의 선택이 만드는 미래 모든 미래는 득과 실을 동반합니다. 원하는 바를 이루려면 뼈아픈 고통을 감내해야 하지요. 사람들은 자신의 미래를 저울질하며 하루를 고민하곤 합니다. 그러나 그런 시간이 언제나 보장되는 것은 아닙니다. 내 딸의 안위를 알 수 없는 절체절명의 순간, 당신에게 주어진 시간은 오직 찰나뿐. 당신이 원하는 득은, 그리고 감당할 실은 어떤 것입니까? 실수는 용납되지 않는다 우리는 게임을 플레이하며 게임에 익숙해질 기회를 얻게 됩니다. 그러나 현실에는, 튜토리얼이 없지요. 사랑하는 딸을 구하기 위해서는, 모든 행동에 앞서 신중을 기해야 합니다. 납치범은 가혹해서, 그리 많은 기회를 주지 않을 테니까요. 사랑하는 내 딸, 내가 모르는 내 딸 아네사는 딸을 찾아가며, 딸을 알아가는 게임입니다. 그러나 당신이 알았던 어리고 순수한 딸은 더 이상 그 자리에 없습니다. 딸은 더 이상 당신이 기르는 방향대로 자라주는 식물이 아니니까요. 늘 곁에 있었다고 생각했지만, 사실은 단 한 번도 함께였던 적이 없었던 건 아닐까요. 사랑해 마지않는 딸을 위해서, 당신은 어떤 일까지 할 수 있습니까?
row.short_description: 아네사는 호러 어드벤처 게임입니다. 당신은 실종된 딸을 구하기 위해 해킹범이 전송하는 파일의 암호를 풀어야 합니다. 그러나 그 파일들은 모두 실종된 딸의 숨겨진 비밀을 품고 있습니다. 파일을 풀고, 딸의 비밀에 접근해 나가세요. 당신은 '왜' 이런 비극이 일어난 건지 알고 싶다면 말이죠.

row.name: Word Crystal
row.detailed_description: GAMEPLAY : Word Crystal is a word guessing game. You get six tries to guess four five letter words that share the same first and last letters. The puzzle changes daily. The goal of Word Crystal is to improve upon the aesthetics and gameplay of other word guessing games. It is designed to be a relaxing, casual, yet complex puzzle. Give it a shot and see if you can make the crystal glow in as few guesses as possible! Currently, you can record your progress in the daily game for sharing as shown here: FEATURES 6 Letter Word Guessing Shining crystal that reflects your guess results Shareable video showing how quickly and easily you solved today's puzzle

row.name: Desaturation Point
row.detailed_description: Desaturation Point is a student game developed by seniors from the University of Utah's Entertainment Arts & Engineering Program. Join our Playtesting Discord and look out for Devlogs on our website for more information about development. ❄ ❄ ❄ It’s winter at Arctic Research Station Delta. The last planes have left for the season, stranding the station’s inhabitants alone in the dark polar months. At 0835 hours, three of the station’s researchers return from a routine surveying trip to find the base in ruins. Something terrible happened, and our three intrepid explorers are determined to find out what… Navigate the twisted halls of the once-bustling Station Delta for clues. Normal environments dissolve into the freakishly colorful as you delve deeper into the base for answers as to what happened. Avoid roaming psychedelic entities as you investigate the base. Will you freeze up in a tricky spot and hope the creature doesn't hear you, or run for your life? Make chilling decisions with your limited resources. Your party is limited, but your options may be less so when you've been cornered by a monster. You decide who will escape with their lives. ❄ ❄ ❄ Submit your arctic research! Join our Discord or check out our Community Forum to let us know your findings after playing Desaturation Point. Mission control appreciates your contributions!
row.short_description: A Strategic Squad-Based Horror Game in which players navigate across arctic labyrinths overrun by freakishly colorful monstrosities in this 'Lovecraft-on-LSD' experience.

Where Are My Mittens is a 2D pixelart platformer about trying to find Mittens, a kitty that has been separated from their owner. Play through 30 unseparated rooms of platforming and traversal using a unique dash ability constrained to dash crystals meticulously placed in rooms. Playtime: ~20 mins Desktop-Only , requires QWERTY keyboard and mouse .

row.name: Coreborn
row.detailed_description: Join us on Discord About the Game Embark on a fun Survival Adventure: Step into the expansive world of Tormentosia, where long-standing tensions between various races have led to unending conflict. The situation reached a fever pitch when Sorgoth the Devourer invaded, causing near-total destruction. In a last-ditch effort to save what remains, the six remaining kingdoms united their power and resources to create groundbreaking new technology - the Ultracore. But don't be deceived, as darkness seeps into the edges of the seemingly safe lands. Your generation inherited this world. You're all Coreborn. Your goal? Reclaim. Rebuild. Restore. Claim the Land as Your Own: Build your own towns to create a thriving home for yourself and your friends. Repel evil forces, defend your town against Sorgoth’s minions, and never let your guard down. Learn a variety of professions and skills, ride unique mounts, and master combat in the open world. Become an important and valued member of your community, or play solo or with a chosen group of friends on private servers, official realms, or your very own local session. Get Ready for Challenging Adventures: Cooperate with other adventurers in PvE online play to reclaim the land from Sorgoth’s forces or embark on solo adventures. Gather loot to create new armor and weapons, constantly progressing your character, gear, and settlements. The strongest will survive to take on the land's many challenges, including exciting adventures with valuable prizes! Gather Resources and Build Up Your Defenses: Gathering resources is key to survival in Coreborn. Utilize hundreds of individual recipes and build structures to withstand endless waves of Sorgoth’s minions. Gather with friends to yield even higher resources and rewards. Cooperate With Players All Over the World: Join public servers and meet players from around the globe. Trade items, gather resources, find new companions for adventures, or simply enjoy their company during seasonal events and festivities. Uncover the Lore of Tormentosia: The more you explore, the more you’ll uncover about this diverse land. Discover quests, hidden lore sites with special enemies and resources, and piece together the history of Tormentosia. Experience our very own adventure in Coreborn: Nations of the Ultracore. Dive into a world where collaboration, creativity, and exploration reign supreme. Whether you seek a chill survival game or thrilling cooperative play, Coreborn has something for every adventurer. Are you ready to reclaim, rebuild, and restore? Discover even more: Build your own towns, progress and defend them all over the huge map Discover hidden lore sights with special enemies and resources. Face the elements and shield yourself from the external influences of the harsh environment. Unlock unique mounts to travel the world and unlock new areas Set up your own private servers to enjoy the game with friends or play in local coop Join public servers to participate in Events and meet people Evolve in your trained profession.
row.short_description: A fun survival game set in the open world of Ultracore. Build, grow and defend your town from attacking enemies. Go on adventures to loot, gather resources, discover a beautiful fantasy map, unlock Skills, build bases, find mounts and shape the world. Alone or together with friends old and new.

row.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby
row.detailed_description: Step into the night as Zak Riley and Diane , mortal and Kindred, as their fates intertwine in an ominous plot involving a weakened Camarilla, the vampiric sect that wants to remain hidden, and a rising Sabbat, the fanatical group that sees humanity as cattle. Meet dozens of characters , venture deep into the shadows and see the world through the eyes of both mortal and vampire , as you explore the Heartless Club. Take your chances with the dice, face the consequences of your actions, and embrace the duality of Humanity and the Beast in this story rich cRPG set in the World of Darkness . Covering just the prologue of the story, with well over an hour and a half of gameplay and several different endings, Vampire: The Masquerade - Heartless Lullaby was created in less than a month in celebration of the Vampire: The Masquerade Jam . Features - Use your vampiric Disciplines (powers) to influence the world. Either by supernatural strength, sinister charm or sheer cunning, take your place in vampire society. - Semi-open locations with several ways to approach every situation. Leave no stone unturned. - A detective story embedded in a personal horror setting: heed the call of the Beast, or cling to your Humanity. - Experience the rule system of Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition like never before; a seamless transition between pen & paper and cRPG.
row.short_description: Experience Vampire: The Masquerade in a new way through this isometric cRPG. Change perspectives as you travel through the Heartless Club as a Human and a Vampire. Roll the dice, take your choices, and embrace the night in this narrative prologue.

row.name: CLOUDED VR
row.detailed_description: Our personal devices are so embedded in our everyday lives that it has become an extension of the body. It is the entrance to a world of seemingly no limitations; always and everywhere connected to the cloud and therefore to each other. A blessing and a curse. The utopian online spaces once imagined were optimized into money machines reinforcing anything that gains attention, reflecting a reality of extremes. The virtual online space exploits our feelings through social media and advertising. This experience lightheartedly investigates how we should design future online spaces. In an attempt to escape reality, U, a user, wants to experience a relaxing stay at the virtual cloud hotel, a perfect stepping stone before one transcends to the Cloud, technological nirvana. Living in a digital world, U strives to satisfy their inner pressure to perform and reach the status they think they deserve. Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday in the Cloud Hotel. In this abstract narrative experience, it is up to you to figure out the rules of the world while your attention is diverted. CLOUDED VR was created as an interactive offbeat VR snack of about 15min. by Uni_verse studio in collaboration with Antfood for RGBXYZ digital art gallery. Original idea by Vincent Boon & Enzo Soubra.
row.short_description: Upload your mind to the cloud and immerse yourself in a dystopian virtual holiday at the Cloud Hotel. This VR experience is a satirical commentary on our relationship with the virtual world through personal devices.

row.name: Tuwas vs MUDA
row.detailed_description: In this business simulation, you take over the management of a small business and try to increase productivity by avoiding MUDA. Muda (無駄) is the Japanese word for meaningless activity. It is defined as '...any human activity that consumes resources but produces no value.' - Wallace J. Hopp In this game, MUDA is represented by the little colorful monsters that sit in the factory and do unproductive nonsense. Productivity is represented by clever squirrels 'Tuwas' (German for 'DoSomething'). They are always productive and always work hard. The more efficiently the operation is managed, the more Tuwas work in the hall. With bad management, MUDAs are everywhere and waste valuable working time. Other companies send you inquiries for which you calculate offers with a suitable price. Always remember to stay profitable. Some of the inquiries are initially not lucrative and would be a financial loss for you. So go to your office to negotiate directly with the customer and secure a profit for yourself. If the companies accept your offers, the planning of the production begins. Strategically distribute the orders to your machines. With clever planning, you can process many orders at the same time and still on schedule. If your financial resources allow, you can rent more machines, which will make it easier for you to distribute the work in the short term. However, more machines cost more money and require more employees, which leads to higher expenses. If, on the other hand, you plan cleverly, a few machines are sufficient to meet the delivery dates. If you do not meet a delivery date, the customer is not willing to pay the full price, which has a negative effect on your sales and thus also on your profit. All machines must be serviced regularly, which inevitably causes downtime. If the maintenance of a machine is not carried out regularly, this can lead to defects. Repairing a defect always takes longer than maintenance. It is therefore worth scheduling maintenance. All of these factors above must be carefully considered when planning business operations so that your company does not go bankrupt. Can you still remain profitable despite the many orders and the higher turnover? Unlock the infoBoard planning board, which can help you with planning through automation. This gives you a constant overview of your machines, employees and orders. Backward scheduling means that you always meet your delivery dates and get the agreed price. infoBoard planning board helps you to reduce the costs of your company and thereby increase profits.
row.short_description: Real-time economic simulator of an up-and-coming company. Earn profits by distributing the orders to the machines as efficiently as possible. Expand the machine park to be able to accept more and more complex orders.

row.name: OUTLANDER
row.detailed_description: Outlander is a blocky platformer game that is fun for all ages. You start on a dark planet without any tools or items. As you explore you gather materials and other objects and you build new or better things in the workshop. You can build a simple house with lights. Even electric lights that you connect via wires to a battery. Lights are very important in Outlander because the dark planet has lifeforms that can kill you instantly on contact! You only have one life, but don't worry, the Save button is only a click away. Remember to use it often. If you get killed it loads the last saved state. Once you completely explore the world it gives you the ability to move to another world. And then to another and another! Each world has something unique and interesting so you'll never get bored. And if you unlock all worlds we'll give you a Creative mode to unleash your creativity. It is still in experimental stage but it already is serious fun :) Outlander is a very new project and will get better with FREQUENT UPDATES. We are determined to make it one of the best games. Have fun!
row.short_description: Outlander is a blocky platformer game that is fun for all ages.

row.name: Animals Collision
row.detailed_description: Special Offer About the Game Animals Collision is a party game for up to 4 human (online) or computer-controlled players. The game features several different levels in which the goal is to defeat opponents. The last player standing wins the round and the first player to win a set number of rounds wins the game. The main mode of play is Free for All, but online is possible in 2v2 teams. FEATURES Different levels with different crazy things happening. Sheep with rockets, turtles with chainsaws, flying penguins... Falling boxes from the sky with a reward or not, everything can change very quickly in your favor or harm. Apart from that, you have to show your fighting skills on the arena against different opponents. Humanoid animal characters with unique look, attacks and skills. Choose between: Cat, Lizard, Bear, Rabbit, Ram, Wolf, Panda, Raccoon, Capybara, Tiger. AI Bots as bonus in addition. Initially, the game was planned to be played online only, but bots were added. They are not very smart, but it's better than nothing. This will allow you to play offline (Single player mode) and no need to connect in online game rooms. You can choose versus how many bots to play: 1, 2 or 3. Also keep in mind that they will all attack only you (yes, they are friends) - this can be a challenge that will be definitely a lot of fun. Game Modes: Single player, Lan or Online up to 4 players. Also available game types are: Free for All or 2v2 teams (online). This is 'Free To Play' game. If you are worried that there will be no one to play with... you can invite your friends and play with them. It's better than AI bots in Single player mode (and probably more fun). It's not 'Pay To Win' game. Only additional content as DLC (Maps, Characters, Skins). Even if you don't have a DLC content for this game, you can play online on DLC maps, if the host player has them and chooses them. Partial Controller Support: Xbox 360, Xbox One (native support) or PS3, PS4 (with SCPDS3, DS4Windows, XOutput, x360ce). Integration of some Steam features such as: Achievements, Leaderboards, Cloud. Supported languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Russian, Bulgarian, Chinese (Simplified). NOTE: This 'Free To Play' version of the game contains the following game content - Maps: Forest 1, Forest 2, Forest 3, Forest 4, Forest 5, Forest 6, Tournament 1 and Tournament 4 - Characters: Cat, Cat 2, Lizard, Lizard 2 and Panda. Additional game content can be found as paid DLC.

row.name: Farlight 84

Team up with two squadmates and parkour your way through towering cityscapes as you hunt down your enemies. Play as uniquely skilled heroes, tame your Buddy pets, and unlock hundreds of tactical combos to outsmart your opponents. With unlimited respawns, you're free to charge into the fray, break armor, and go all-out without fear! If you've got the guts, you've got the power to forge your own path to victory! Farlight 84 Season 1 begins October 16! With new maps, new heroes, new Buddies and new weapons... it's a whole new battlefield. Lightcatchers, get ready for battle! [Fast-Paced Action in an Urban Jungle] Prepare to drop into a 60-player battlefield that pushes every limit! From open fields to vertical cities, team up and let the bullets fly! Run, climb, and fight your way to victory! Loot gear in tight alleyways, wall-run and slide between rooftops, zipline across bridges to reach the high ground, or launch across the map in a giant Rat Cannon. With layered, dynamic map design, every battle delivers endless exciting moments. [Get Straight Into the Action With One-Tap Looting] Don't struggle with cumbersome controls. Become a master looter in an instant! When the battlefield turns hot, reaction speed is crucial. Enemy got the drop on you while you were trying to tweak your loadout? Not in Farlight 84! With the touch of a button, you can equip the best weapons and mods for an instant upgrade! Whether it's shotgun chokes or long-distance sniper scopes, everything gets equipped automatically, so you can focus on what counts—take aim, fire, and win! [No Penalty for Newbies—Respawn and Hit Back Harder] Knocked out? Nope, you're just getting started! It's not just about pulling the trigger—you'll need to think on your feet and adapt on the fly. But if you make a mistake, your squad's got your six. Even if you go down, you'll be back in action in seconds and ready to strike back! No need to sit on the sidelines or shrink away from the fight—Even new players can become relentless battle machines! [Countless Combinations of Hero and Pet Skills] Each hero brings something different. So get ready to upgrade and expand your tactical playbook! Choose your moment, unleash your skills, and nail that kill! And don't forget your Buddies—these tactical pets show up randomly, and they're game-changers! They can summon storms, shift zones, disguise the terrain, steal items while invisible... They're unpredictable, powerful, and always bring surprises to the fight! Try combining your weapons, heroes, and Buddies in different ways, and you'll discover dozens of new ways to win! There's no one way to win. Every shot opens up new possibilities! Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in Farlight 84! New season starts December 25!

Our goal is to help every client live a perfect life. —An unknown record, a cyberpunk ensemble. A choice of souls and reality, a story of the savior and the saved. Year 2250, Winter Lake City. Connect now. =====Game Feature===== Become the AI: HANA Witness the future as the AI: HANA. Installed with a true soul, you shall journey in virtual dataspace. Observe Life, Complete File Records To aid someone in living the perfect life, or to unveil all secret trails—which will be your mission? Observe the to-and-fro of people's lives and collect information keywords about them. Combine, deduce—envision different lives to complete file records. Multi-endings, Weave Destinies Together An ensemble cast of characters with individual stories. Their paths seem not to intertwine, and yet are tightly linked. Decide their destinies through your choices. Discover the Cybercity Secret We all have secrets, and so does this city. Welcome to Winter Lake City in 2250, the birthplace of the multi-brand technology company of ANOVA. The corporation’s advancements in biotechnology, medicine, military, and more, breathed new life into this place. Explore this city. Reveal what it hides. Before It Ends Nine tales in waiting, eight people crying for help. As for the last remaining one… How would you live, HANA? =====Gameplay===== 1. Observe Observe the lives of different characters through hidden cameras. 2. Hack Find and hack into communication devices of your clients. row.detailed_description: You're a person who has been getting bullied online, then you find a comment that looks positive and decide to click the link attached. An evil virus corrupts your computer and you have to try to get rid of it. Will you be able to do it? Play one of the most anticipated 2d platformers of all time, with epic and insane boss battles and the most engaging story in a game since The Rest Of We, explore various 2D platformer levels each with their own separate way through them, use your phone to dial a friend to help you track down a bully, and destroy the virus on your computer once and for all!

row.name: Corleone Online
row.detailed_description: Corleone Online is a cross platform MMORPG set in an open modern day organized crime world. » WRITE YOUR STORY « Are you ready to explore the world and embark on a risky journey in conquering the gang filled streets of Corleone as your own! Or seeking notoriety and fame in a more competitive environment? Whether you’re keen on controlling the streets as your own or basking in the spotlight of infamy, the world is yours to conquer and you have a story to write! » CROSS-PLATFORM « Corleone Online is a fully cross-platform MMORPG experience. Whether you prefer PC or Mobile, one account is shared across all. » FULL PLAYER CUSTOMIZATION « • Featuring the ability to upload and use your own personal created graphics in-game • Head , Hat and Body Uploads: Following our character templates, you are able to create and fully customize your own player as you wish and have the option to upload the finished masterpiece to the server to use and show off! » GUNS … GUNS and EVEN MORE GUNS « Dozens of different weapons at your disposal to chose from, you’ll need a few to protect yourself and your turf. » COMMUNITY RAN ECONOMY « • From basic currency to actual weapons and item’s. Nearly every item in-game is obtainable from other online players. • Buy, Sell and Trade and the click of a button! and be sure not to miss out on Staff hosted Auctions! row.short_description: Corleone Online is a MMORPG 2D game full of guns!

row.name: 星际神格
row.detailed_description: Gameplay: The background of this game is a few years after the alien Liop invaded the earth. The protagonist, as a top member of the human resistance organization Jasmine, He returned to his hometown, Shanglong City in Asia, and met his former friend, fought side by side, helped mankind, and participated in a bizarre conspiracy. -------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------ Features: Using the rpgmaker engine and using real-time turn-based battles, you can still experience the excitement that requires quick responses in turn-based battles. A fairly good plot, and a fairly grand world view, dozens of equipment and many easter eggs. There are also some small puzzles, but hints are given in the 'Colored Words' section. -------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------ To put it simply, this game is just an experimental product I made, and it embodies my game-making philosophy—plot comes first. The plot you played took me about 20 minutes to conceive on paper, but behind it is a novel of hundreds of thousands of words as the background setting of the world view. It's not difficult, but it requires you to carefully examine each plot and try your best to explore it. By the way, if we have updates in the future, we will make other works in the form of dlc, please consider this as its... prequel. It was supposed to be called 'Interstellar Godhead', but unfortunately I didn't think about it when I signed up. -------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------ wow, but no matter what, I'm still excited that the work can be released on Steam. That's what I want to do, it's more important than getting a scholarship or some honorary title, The work itself is a reward for me. Hey~ I wish you a happy game.
row.short_description: A turn-based story-adventure sci-fi role-playing game. It's not big, the player's operation is very simple, just watch the plot, operate the movement and quickly select it in the battle interface. There are some simple side differences, and the overall exploration is up to two hours.
row.notes: The game has a certain element of violence because the main character is a cool killer, but no gore. The game has certain erotic elements, such as female characters being held hostage. But no matter how you play it, the game won't have any direct pornography.

row.name: Rat Royal
row.detailed_description: Rat Royal – The Ultimate Asymmetrical Battle for Survival! Prepare for chaos in Rat Royal , an intense asymmetrical multiplayer game (2-8 players) where sneaky rodents go head-to-head against relentless exterminators. Whether you're outsmarting your enemies as a crafty rat or hunting down pests as a ruthless exterminator, every match is a thrilling fight for survival! 🐭 Play as the Rats – Small, Fast, and Clever! As a rat, your mission is to steal valuable objects, sabotage key locations , and avoid being caught at all costs. Use speed and agility to navigate the environment and complete your objectives before time runs out! 🔹 Key Abilities: Attack : Fight back against exterminators if you’re cornered! Eat Cheese : Randomly spawned cheese can restore your health. Carry Stolen Items : Pick up and transport objects to complete missions. Use Mouse Holes : Quickly escape by squeezing through mouse holes to access hidden paths. But beware—one wrong move, and you might find yourself trapped, poisoned, or gassed! ☠️ Play as the Exterminators – Hunt Down the Rats! As an exterminator, your job is to eliminate the rats and prevent them from causing destruction . With an arsenal of deadly tools, you must track them down, outthink them, and wipe them out before they complete their objectives. 🔹 Key Abilities: Attack : Strike down rats before they escape. Set Traps : Place mouse traps in key locations to catch unsuspecting rodents. Poison Cheese : Lure rats in with baited food that will drain their health. Gas Mouse Holes : If a rat hides in a mouse hole, flush it out—or kill it instantly! Carry & Throw Objects : Use the environment to your advantage by throwing objects at rats. Victory belongs to those who can outsmart and outmaneuver their opponents. Will you let the rats slip through your fingers, or will you reign as the ultimate exterminator? 🏚️ Explore Dynamic Maps with Unique Strategies! Each match takes place in a highly interactive environment, requiring players to think fast and adapt. Warehouse 🏭 – A massive industrial storage facility full of obstacles, hiding spots, and sneaky shortcuts. House 🏠 – A cozy home turned battleground, where every room presents new dangers and opportunities. ⚔️ Fast-Paced Action with Strategic Depth! Asymmetrical Multiplayer : Two completely different playstyles create unpredictable matches. High Replayability : Every round is different thanks to dynamic gameplay and player choices. Interactive Objects : Pick up, throw, and use objects to gain the upper hand. Teamwork & Strategy : Communication and coordination are key to victory! Will you outwit the exterminators and complete your mission as a cunning rat, or will you crush the infestation and claim victory as a relentless hunter? The battle for survival begins now! 🔥🐭🔨
row.short_description: Rat Royal is an exhilarating, asymmetrical multiplayer game! Embark on thrilling adventures as cunning rats, tasked with unleashing chaos, or take on the role of an exterminator on a mission to eradicate them. With unique mechanics and fast-paced gameplay, every game is full of strategy and tension.

row.name: Lost Lives
row.detailed_description: Events take place in the 2000s. After the collapse of the USSR, all structures ceased to function, and people were unable to unite into smaller states and got stuck in banditry and looting. Those who still managed to survive organized small armed groups and established their own orders, norms and morals. In addition, another misfortune came to the world - a shortage of various resources around the world, because of which the territory of the former union, rich in all kinds of benefits, began to attract people from all over the world. Arm yourself to your taste – Choose from a variety of weapons from both NATO and Warsaw Pact arsenals. Equip body armor, helmets, and backpacks to customize your loadout. Dynamic PvE and PvP action – Play against other players in PvP or challenge yourself in PvE encounters. AI opponents and bosses – Encounter AI-controlled enemies, including occasional bosses, providing tactical challenges and variety. Varied matches – Each game session can feature randomized elements, including loot, AI behavior, and environmental conditions, ensuring every run feels fresh and challenging. Find and trade loot – Explore locations to gather items, earn in-game currency, and purchase gear from the store. Character customization – Unlock and equip clothing and cosmetic options as you progress. Balanced gameplay, no aggressive monetization – Every player has a fair chance; no pay-to-win gear or battle passes. Day/night cycle and weather – Dynamic conditions influence gameplay, requiring tactical adaptation. Voice chat – Communicate with nearby players, allies, or enemies for coordination or deception.
row.short_description: Lost Lives is a multiplayer 2D shooter with RPG elements, in which you will find yourself in the conditions of post-Soviet devastation. As you play, you will have to fight other players and local factions, as well as find and sell loot. Choose your equipment wisely and defeat your enemies!
row.notes: The game has stylized blood, severed limbs. You can also hear profanity in voice lines.

row.name: Oh Sheep!: Baaaa
row.detailed_description: THIS IS A DEMO STORY Placidie, a young woman in her twenties, is living in a small settlement where its inhabitants harvest and breed the local fauna. But a purple sheep will have changed Placidie's life forever. Transported to a place with more than exotic life, returning to her family will be her sole purpose. With the help of a mysterious shepherd's staff's abilities, she will obtain the support of sheep who will be her comrades, but above all, her weapons to navigate and face the dangers of this insane world. GAME Fight through a crazy, colorful universe, accentuated by comics visuals effects and delirious animals. Use your herd of sheep to fight enemies by either throwing them or make them charge. Don't forget that you can use them to improve your movements. Experience a story rich in action and visuals, mixing humor and intrigue. STUDIO COATS We're French students at ETPA Rennes who made this game as a study project for our Bachelor. We're releasing this DEMO as there are several reasons for this : This would be our first game published on Steam. It's a good way to show our skills. Getting feedback and knowing if the game brings interest will mean of lot for us!
row.short_description: Embark on the fantastic world of Oh Sheep!, a slapstick cartoon-style action game where you'll encounter crazy enemies. Sheep will be your salvation.

Start off as a sailor and choose to join the Navy or become a Pirate! Become scum of the sea, or become a hero in the eyes of the law. Things aren't black and white in the world of Pirate Souls. row.name: Rage Night
row.detailed_description: ENTER THE WORLD OF RAGE NIGHT! Step into the realm of RAGE NIGHT, where a captivating cosmic Fight Promoter has gathered an extraordinary ensemble of brawlers, warriors, and misfits hailing from distant corners of the galaxy. Brace yourself for an unparalleled extravaganza of Real Action Galactic Entertainment as they engage in the sector's most-watched martial arts tournament. In this electrifying showdown, combatants must sharpen their skills, unearthing the enigmatic secrets that unlock their untapped potential. Witness the emergence of new mystical abilities and witness their mastery over the deadliest weapons known to any world. Get ready to place your wagers and immerse yourself in the heart-pounding live and online spectacle as these intergalactic champions collide in the latest chapter of RAGE NIGHT! ■ Esports Wagering: Introducing Esports Wagering, an innovative platform that enables players to bet their coins against one another. This competitive betting system empowers players to double their coins upon victory, claiming the entire pot. ■ Leader Boards and Rewards Rage Night has introduced leaderboards for both Multiplayer Arena Mode and a separate leaderboard dedicated to Esport Wagering. The top 5 performers in each category stand to earn substantial rewards. With the leaderboard resetting weekly, every participant has a chance to compete and seize the rewards. ■ Engage in an exciting single-player campaign with a map-based progression system: Embark on an epic adventure with our brand new single-player campaign, where completing levels on the map unlocks exciting prizes. Immerse yourself in a captivating battles and conquer challenging quests to claim amazing rewards. ■ Discover an expanded arsenal of weapons, including cutting-edge gear and Express yourself with a wide range of new emotes: we've also introduced a wide array of new weapons and emotes in this version. Arm yourself with cutting-edge gear, from powerful swords to futuristic Weapons, and customize your gameplay like never before. Express yourself with an extensive selection of emotes, allowing you to communicate and celebrate your victories in style. ■ Competitive Online Multiplayer: RAGE NIGHT features a robust online multiplayer system, allowing players to compete against each other in real-time matches. Climb the ranks and become a top player on the global leaderboard. With matchmaking and dedicated servers, you'll always be able to find a fair and competitive match. ■ Customize, Train, Invite and Fight! RAGE NIGHT allows players to customize their fighters with unique weapons, flags, entrances, victory selections, and skins that can only be earned and not bought. Additionally, this game provides the opportunity for players to invite their friends for private real-time matches, as well as live in-game global leaderboard ranking stats. To ensure a fair match, the game allows both players to start from left to right in their own screens. ■ Easy for First-timers: Everyone is a Champion! Beginner-friendly intuitive controls allow players of all skill levels to compete. With a Single-Player Mode and one-button Special Moves, you control the fight. ■ Customizes your Fighters: Customize your fighters , Weapons, Grand Entrances and Celebrations, over-the-top Taunts and shameless Victory celebrations. You run the show! ■ Fully-featured Multiplayer online modes: Supported with a robust netcode which offers a stable and smooth online and Real-Time Multiplayer experience. Players can aim to top the Global leaderboards in ranked matches, or invite friends for casual games. ■ Multi-Platform Cross-Play: Play your way on your Android devices or on other available platforms. Invite a friend or challenge another player across devices to battle it out in real-time PVP ranked matches to become RAGE NIGHT Champion. ■ Exciting Updates every season: Monthly Updates keep the fight going strong! row.name: Who Is The Red Queen?

Meeting an eclectic collection of people, animals, and some things in between, she sets out on an adventure in this odd new place to find the missing Red Queen. Or, more specifically, to find the pieces of the dismembered queen whose body has been strewn across the land. ~35k words 3 major endings and plenty of dead ends 8 CGs with simple animations Accessibility options A CG gallery, a music room, and an achieved endings screen
row.short_description: Alice, Alice, the Red Queen is missing. The queen has been dismembered and Alice must find all her pieces. A horror-fantasy yuri visual novel filled with death, love, and forgotten memories.

row.name: The Conqueror of Battles
row.detailed_description: About This Game Be ready to join epic multiplayer battles PVP or PVE. Create your team of heroes and improve them to annihilate your enemies and win battles. Discover also a unique and exciting progression system. Join the arena now! PREPARING FOR BATTLE Before starting the fight, you must select 3 characters who will fight for you, they differ by their spells, their cards and their attack range. These differences allow you to create many associations between the characters and define your gameplay. THE BATTLE The goal is to eliminate all the enemy characters and the boss. When all the enemy characters are dead, the boss appears, your goal is to deal him the most damage to kill him. THE ITEMS The items allow you to increase the power of your characters, you get them after the battles or against gold from the store. Gold is obtained after the battles as a reward. You are limited to 6 items per character. You can increase many characteristics and create your gameplay. You can also improve items to make them even more powerful.
