row.name: MythBusters: The Game - Crazy Experiments Simulator Playtest
BAWs Pharmacy
row.detailed_description: BAW’s Pharmacy is a mobile time management and strategy game. Players manage a medical warehouse and sell products to hospitals and clinics. Customers will approach the sales counter and request a specific item for purchase. With the increase in need due to COVID-19, players must move quick to select the right product! Correct choices result in currency allowing players to purchase additional stock and upgrades. Upgrades can help to keep customers happy and make your store more efficient! At the end of each workday, players review their data to determine which supplies are best to invest in using box and whisker plots. Choose carefully to ensure your store has what it needs to succeed! Directions for BaW’s Pharmacy Welcome to BaW’s Pharmacy, this document will give you a general guide on how to play the game. In this game you run a pharmacy that provides products from face masks to pain pills. Main Menu When you load up the game there will be a main menu where you will have to write your name or username and sign in. Once you write your username, press the Sign In button and then the Play button will become available. There will also be many other different buttons. Firstly, the Play button will take you into the main game and allow you to run the store and do your post daily box and whisker graphs. The How to Play button will take you to a screen that will explain how different aspects of the game work. The Options button will take you to a screen that allows you to change sounds and other options within the game. The Trivia button will put you through different box and whisker graph scenarios and allow you to practice there on them.   Main Game - Running the Store In the main game you will control the person behind the counter. As customers come into your store and approach the counter, they will have an image and a timer above their heads. The image depicts what item the customer is requesting. The orange image behind the image of the item will slowly disappear as a customer waits in line and for their item, this represents a customer’s patience. Patience will be important because if a customer’s patience runs out, they will get upset and leave the store, causing you to lose your sale. When a customer approaches and you want to make a sale to them, you need to tap on the icon above their head. When you tap on the icon the store inventory will open and you must then tap on the correct item and then confirm so that your pharmacist can go to the back of the store and grab the item. The pharmacist will return and give the item to the customer making a sale. You can use upgrades within the store too. There are several upgrades you can acquire and next to each upgrade there is a description telling you what it does. Then you can continue working until the end of the day is reached.   Main Game - End of Day Graph At the end of each day you will be taken to a screen that will show a box and whisker graph that is generated by your sales throughout the day. The data values that should appear on the bottom of the graph are scrambled on the right side of the screen and you will need to drag and drop them into the correct place to continue onto the next day. If you need a detailed walkthrough on box and whisker graphs it is recommended visiting the how to play or the tutorial. That is about it on the instructions for BaW’s Pharmacy! While in the game if more help is needed just visit the how to play, the trivia or the tutorial in game and these will explain again how to play BaW’s Pharmacy successfully.
row.short_description: BAW’s Pharmacy is a mobile time management and strategy game. Players manage a medical warehouse and sell products to hospitals and clinics. Customers will approach the sales counter and request a specific item for purchase.

row.name: You Deserve a Seat at the Table
row.detailed_description: You Deserve a Seat at the Table provides players with the right tools to excel in corporate environments. This 2D Puzzle game offers an exciting alternative to common dull approaches. Ordinary business concepts such as Critical Thinking and Problem Solving are taught through interactive mini-games. Working your way up the corporate ladder can be tough, but it doesn’t have to be! With You Deserve A Seat, players can simulate a learning experience built to help them succeed. After arriving to their first day of work, players are led to the Board roam to learn tricks of the trade. They are given the option to select a Board Member and complete the corresponding puzzle. Each Board Member represents a concept and offers insight into becoming successful. Mini-games like dice stacking teaches players how to find creative solutions when unusual difficulties occur. Tips will trigger at the start of all mini-games and can applied to real world situations. From preparing for a first interview to building a solid rapport with your boss. These will be sure to come in handy across all office settings. How to Play There are three professional concepts to explore that teach valuable skills and values. Each concept serves as a level and has its own mini game for an interactive experience. At your discretion, levels can be selected and played in any order. All will include tips and a tutorial narrated by the 'Working Joe' character. Player Identification After the game has loaded, you are given the opportunity to enter your name before playing. There is no requirement on the length of name provided nor are nicknames prohibited. Level Selection Once you have finalized your preferred name on the previous screen. You will be introduced to the board room with its accompanying members. To select your desired level, hover over the mini game name attributed to the specified member. Before each mini game, there will be a randomly selected tip displayed on the game screen. Each tip will relate to the selected concept and provide more insight into professionalism. As one tip cannot encompass all experiences in the corporate world, there will be an assortment with every level selection. Mini Game Levels Creativity (Dice Stacking) Creativity in the workplace allows for collaboration and fresh new ideas that could be beneficial to the company. If you are faced with a problem that you are unable to solve, being creative can help you to be more flexible in your approach. You can examine all sides of the issue to gain inspiration and be innovative in your solution. This mini game helps to promote creativity by presenting you with a unique problem requiring experimentation. In learning to stack the dice, you are building up your creative skill through thinking outside of the box. 1. Click and drag to rotate the screen. 2. Use the scroll to zoom in and out. 3. Right click and hold to drag the dice. 4. Drag the dice onto another 5. Win this game by completing and building a full stack of dice Critical Thinking (Chess) Being able to think critically in the workplace shows that you are a valuable asset to the team and a potential leader. This skill helps you to focus more on details and take logical steps to diagnose problems. In fact, this could lead to finding errors and irregularities in your work resulting in a higher quality. Chess has proven to be beneficial in increasing intelligence, memory, and perspective. Regularly engaging in a game is not only useful in those areas but also in furthering your Critical Thinking. 1. Players tap on the chess pieces then tap on the desired square. 2. Each chess piece (both player and opponent) has health points. 3. Win this game by eliminating your opponent’s chess pieces. Problem Solving (Trivia) Another indicator of potential leadership is effectively solving complex problems within the workplace. This shows you are proactive in your approach and determined to get things done. In the long run, this could help to save time and money by making it easier for others to understand certain things. Trivia is an excellent way to exercise your problem-solving skills. This mini game is all about outsmarting your opponent through careful answer selection. You will navigate through an office building using your knowledge of office etiquette until you reach the top floor. 1. Use your phone to swipe in the direction that you’d like to move. 2. You can only move one tile at a time until chosen again. 3. When you land on an Enemy tile, a trivia question will appear on your screen 4. Tap the appropriate responses on the Trivia Screen to continue 5. When the correct response is chosen, you are able to continue moving through the level. 6. Win the game by making it to the 10th floor, representing a promotion.

row.name: Local Paper Small Town
row.detailed_description: Local Paper Small Town is a 2-player co-op puzzle game about spreading happiness around a quirky papercraft town. Team up with a friend, using a physical newspaper and VR, to discover Smalltown and its charming cast of characters by communicating and relating between both formats. One player explores the town in VR, solving puzzles by moving cardboard cutout characters around, entering codes, and working with the second player to fill in their newspaper crossword puzzle and deducing each character's story and place in the game world. The second player, equipped with the PDF of the Smalltown newspaper, reads and scans pages for clues that may help both players advance the game state by solving puzzles in VR thanks to their shared understanding of the characters, similar to a collaborative escape room, but with more narrative flavouring. * * * How to play: In this two-player experience, one player is equipped with a newspaper from a fictional Canadian town, and the other player explores a papercraft version of this town in virtual reality. Please find the newspaper PDF in the game folder. This game is for two players: one with the newspaper, one playing VR. The game lasts about one hour , and is best played in local co-op with a speaker for both players to hear the audio. Be sure to communicate well with your partner to solve puzzles, discover character stories, and complete the game. VR player: In addition to teleporting, you can grab characters and move them around to solve puzzles. Newspaper player: The game was designed to be played with the newspaper player not seeing the game screen. However, if you prefer to have an easier time, you could check what the other player is seeing in VR. Have fun in Smalltown! * * * Created as a mixed media semester project at the Cologne Game Lab. Nominated for the Ubisoft Newcomer Award at the German Developer Awards 2020.

row.name: Love and Guillotines
row.detailed_description: Love and Guillotines is a visual novel dating sim which allows the player to romance prominent figures of the French Revolution. Experience your first day at 'Vive La University' as you navigate the ins-and-outs of the schools prominent 'Political Society Club'. Will the president of the club, Max, catch your eye? Or maybe the young playwright, Oly? The choice is yours in this work of historical fiction and romance. During the beginning of the pandemic I was reading a book titled 'Twelve Who Ruled' by RR Palmer. The book is about the Committee of Public Safety and it's members during the period known as the 'Year of Terror' in France. It's a great book, very informative. I highly recommend it if you're into that period of history. But there was something I just couldn't shake... These men were all so interesting with such strong personalities and crazy drama, so why... Had no one put them in a visual novel dating sim yet? This is how Love and Guillotines was born. A visual novel video game which allows you to woo the most powerful figures of the French Revolution. Be careful to stay on everyone's good side, or you might just lose your head. Script: Ellen Noel Programming: Chilliac Character Art: Emily Horn Additional Resources: Florassence CreaPracticus Patat0Master
row.short_description: A visual novel video game which allows you to woo the most powerful figures of the French Revolution. Be careful to stay on everyone's good side, or you might just lose your head.

row.name: 推推炸(PushPushBoom)
row.detailed_description: How to move Use the WSAD keyboard to move up, down, left and right. After clicking, the character will move accordingly. When it moves a space, it will stop. If you still click the move key in the corresponding direction, the character will continue to move without stopping. How to defeat monsters Pushing the square stones and fruits in the map is the main attack method. You can also use diaper bombs to kill monsters when you become a baby. Some pitaya fruits in the map also have the effect of bombs, which can also kill monsters. Note that some special monsters cannot be killed by pushing stones and fruits, but diaper bombs are effective. When a player is touched by a monster, the player fails. A level can be revived once through the vitality potion. How to pass Each level has specific requirements. The requirements are displayed in the upper left corner. It is required to display the number of monsters destroyed and the number of fruits destroyed. The current completed number will also be displayed. The shorter the time it takes to complete the task, the higher the clearance evaluation will be. Game fruit props, etc In order for players to pass the level more easily, there are fruit props that can be used in the game. The props are used to slow down monsters, dizziness monsters, or even kill monsters directly. The most important thing is that you will die when being approached by monsters in the game, but you can use resurrection (you need to use 5 points of vitality potion) How to get prop fruit Most of the fruit props are purchased from stores, but when you complete some achievements, you can get rewards from the achievement system, as well as a small amount of fruit props. It also includes vitality potion. How to get gold coins You can get gold coins by killing all kinds of food monsters in the level. Note that the higher the level score, the more gold coins you will get. When a stone crushes more monsters, the points will double. Game content obtained in this version This version can obtain 50 levels of game content. Players can obtain gold coins and buy game props through the game.

row.name: WAR OPERATION™ : Full Contact
row.detailed_description: Early Beta Access The first version of Early Access sends you straight back to April 2003, in the heart of Iraq, in the midst of a frighteningly intense confrontation. Scoot around the streets of Baghdad, near Firdos Square, frozen in the days of Saddam Hussein's regime. A unique and exceptional experience never seen before. About the Game Iraq, April 2003  - The United States and its allies launch Operation Iraqi Freedom , supposedly to rid the country of weapons of mass destruction and toppling from its dictator Saddam Hussein. In the wake of the devastating 9/11 attacks, President George W. Bush is determined to seek historic revenge against what he calls the Axis of Evil . From the streets of Baghdad to the rugged mountains of Tora Bora, WAR OPERATION™: Full Contact thrusts you into the heart of the most intense modern conflicts. A museum-grade reconstruction of Baghdad’s historic Firdos Square and many other key locations immerses you in a truly unique and powerful experience. WAR OPERATION™: Full Contact , in its very first early access version, offers 16-versus-16 game modes: Team Deathmatch , Zone Capture ,  Rescue, and Statue-Toppling modes -   all set across stunning and realistic modern-day environments in a fast-paced third-person shooter experience. Technical features of Early Access - First Version 1 iconic map: Firdos Square 2 camps: The American marines against the Iraqi Army including the Fedayeen. 4 gamemodes : Team deathmatch, Zone control, Rescue, Toppling mode Integrated online chat Online Ranking A unique soundtrack Dynamic gameplay and characters movements Dynamic sound system

row.name: ​Triple Fantasy
row.detailed_description: ■ Three Cards, Triple Fun - Unique tactical TCG, CCG among card games! - If you like RPG games, you will definitely love Triple Fantasy! Triple Fantasy is a cute pixel design, but it's a card battle game with a deep strategy. The player plays with a total of 27 cards. The goal is to strategically combine 3 cards to defeat the enemy. You receive 6 cards at the start and attack with 3 cards at each turn. In other words, the combination of the 3 cards should be used strategically. Sometimes you need to throw away cards to win the battle. Cards come in a total of 4 classes. There are 'Steel' class that deals damage, 'Faith' class that heals and manages crowd control skills, 'Magic' class that deals Area of Effect skills, and the special 'Wild' class that can be used in any situation. There are also various 'Jobs' such as Warrior, Monk, Sorcerer, etc. There are also Water, Earth, and Fire elements. The game is similar to the basic rules of poker such as Double, Flush, and Straight. Tremendous damage can be given or the HP can be healed by multiplying the damage through combining each Class, Job, and Element. There are more than 300 cards, and you can make your own deck through the obtained resources. Now enjoy the game with your own cards and your own strategy. ■ Free welcome-gifts for new users are awaiting! - We are giving everyone 500 free summons! - Complete the mission and earn the Mythic Cards! ■ A card collecting game with unique dot characters - Sun Wukong, Thor, Odin, and characters from 'Romance of the three kingdoms?!' Meet familiar legends in the adventure! - Collect over 300 pixel art heroes! One of the best card collecting RPG games! - From normal heroes to legends! Collect cards in various tiers and become stronger! ■ Various contents that will never go boring - The basis of strategy games! Expand the world with your one and only deck! [Outpost] - Attack monsters with different elements! Rewards depending on the strategy! [Goblin Mine] - A true strategy card game enjoyed by random cards! Thrilling turn-based PVP! [Arena] - Collect unique dot heroes hidden somewhere in the map! [Monster Dungeon] - Defeat various monsters with powerful card combinations! The real tactical RPG game! [Lab] - Use tactics in the PVP as well! Fun triples in Card battle games when enjoyed together! [Devil's Ruins] - NO Grinding! The real-time battle only with card strategy skills! [Unknown Portal] Enjoy strategy games with cute dot heroes! One of the best card battle RPG games! Download now!

row.name: Gabriel's Auditory Playground
row.detailed_description: This game is an experiment and no longer in development! Gabriel's Auditory Playground has no graphics, no visuals, no way to experience the gameplay with your eyes. In Gabriel's Auditory Playground, your eyes have no use. Put your ears to the test and play through a variety of mini-games designed without sight in mind such as: Zombie Survival - Survive an increasing amount of the living dead as you fend them off with nothing but your ears and a big, stinkin' gun. They're closing in from every direction, how many will you take down with you? Ninja Knockout - Ninjas to the left of you, more ninjas to the right, here you are, stuck in the middle with... two fists. In this mini-game inspired by 'One Finger Death Punch', get ready for a brutal beat-down and knockout limitless ninjas coming from either side! Not Enough Cooks - Put on your apron as a criminally underpaid fast food worker that's on their last warning. Get three orders wrong and you'll be back in the unemployment line! Can you survive your shift? In this mini-game inspired by 'Overcooked', build burgers to order in a very busy restaurant! row.short_description: Gabriel's Auditory Playground has no graphics, no visuals, no way to experience the gameplay with your eyes. In Gabriel's Auditory Playground, your eyes have no use. Put your ears to the test and play through mini-games designed without sight in mind!

He will find something new, indeed, but will his discovery be a dangerous one? Features: Point and click escape room game Unique and immersive storyline Play to unravel an intriguing story Find hidden objects and solve different puzzles to progress Progress aware hint system Autosave system Supporting 2 different languages
row.short_description: A point and click escape adventure where you discover the life of Professor Wilson by solving all the mysteries of his story.

row.name: Tank Top Tactics
row.detailed_description: Tank Top Tacitcs - Where tanks and objects can be on top of each other, and that has a huge impact on the tactical possibilities! Turn-based gameplay enables you to plan out every single action carefully Control your individual tanks on a grid-based field, make them MOVE, GRAB, SHOOT and SELF-DESTRUCT! Each player has one 'Main Tank' among their units, and if that tank gets destroyed, the battle is decided! Choose from 6 different battle fields that each offer unique tactical possibilities for you to discover! Unleash the creative tactician within you to outplay your opponent either locally or ONLINE!

row.name: Royal Duality
row.detailed_description: Let the story begin... Explore the world of Royal Duality with a mysterious and cryptic narrator. Make choices that will change the lives of the characters of the tale, and the world they live in. Discover hidden side stories, unlock all the endings and complete the compendium to reveal the truth behind this captivating plot and unlock the true motives of the mysterious 'Guardian of Stories' Multiple character POVS 15 endings 12 bonus scenes Partially Voice Acted Over 30 CGs 74k words 15 hours completion time This game contains dark themes. There is a full content warning available before the game begins. “I haven’t seen a human for quite some time. Welcome, I am the guardian of stories. You came here to experience ‘Royal Duality’...one of the most important tales in my world. A small group from the Final Fae Kingdom are on a quest to find the powerful wizard, Oliver Lunastella, who has gone missing in the realm of the evil vampire Count Helmrick, who lives in the now desolate Evergreen Castle that once belonged to the Fae...or at least, that’s the story it told, the last time I read it…The narrative can be changed you see...by you.'
row.short_description: Royal Duality is an immersive dark fantasy visual novel with 15 endings, various side stories and hidden Easter Eggs all set in an engaging lore-rich world
row.reviews: “You’ll like Royal Duality if you like: lore-rich fantasy settings to sink your teeth into; free indie games with a lot of charm; English original games that shake up the traditional, Japanese format; fairies, vampires, and other magical beings; and narrative-driven games that don’t focus solely on the romance…” Sweet and Spicy “There’s a lot of content to digest in this fantasy game that will quickly get dark if you make the wrong decision. row.name: Whispers of the village
row.detailed_description: Whispers of the Village is an investigation game where you play as a fortune teller. As you enter a small village, you are overwhelmed by a terrible vision of the village ravaged by flames. Thanks to your divination skills, which tells you the future through tea leaves, you'll find clues in empty cups that will help you understand how the disaster will happen. Atypical and captivating characters:  Meet four villagers who come to your caravan every day to talk and drink tea. The four days leading to the disaster will lead you to grow closer to them, and discover more of their stories, personalities and secrets... Play as a tasseomancer :  You will have to find clues in the villagers' tea leaves through a series of shape matches. Each shape has its own meaning, and each combination and positioning of shapes must be interpreted to understand what is happening and will happen in the village. Take notes:  In your trusty notebook, you can record information obtained from your discussions with your visitors. This could be about their work, their relationships, or the predictions you've made for them. And solve the investigation:  Use stamps depicting the four villagers, as well as actions and objects. Place these stamps on drawings representing the different places in your vision to create sentences explaining the events to come. Once you've matched the right stamps with the right drawings, and put the drawings back into chronological order, the mystery surrounding the disaster will be solved. This Game include:  4 characters who will open up to you as you progress. A captivating story that will take you deeper into the hearts of your visitors. A calm and cosy atmosphere in your caravan, despite the looming disaster. 24 puzzles to help you solve and understand the mystery. 2 hours of immersive play and reading.
row.short_description: You arrive in a small village as a fortune-teller who reads the future in tea leaves. But an apocalyptic vision leads you to question its tranquillity. What if you had a part to play in this? Ready your cups and tea leaves, as the future of this village will be shaped by four unusual visitors.

row.name: Alone in the Dark Prologue
row.detailed_description: Alone in the Dark Prologue is an atmospheric Playable Teaser for the upcoming re-imagination of Alone in the Dark – the game which gave birth to the survival horror genre. One of Derceto’s residents, Jeremy Hartwood, has been acting strange lately. He asks Grace to do one simple thing – help him deliver a letter to his niece, Emily Hartwood. She seems to be the only one capable of understanding the otherworldly horrors plaguing Jeremy’s mind. Experience the haunting atmosphere of Derceto Manor, where psychological horror meets Southern Gothic, from the seemingly innocent perspective of Grace Saunders. Dive into the eldritch nightmare of Alone in the Dark in this exclusive first taste of Alone in the Dark’s full experience. If you make it to the end, be ready for a very special surprise… Grace agrees and embarks on a short yet memorable trip through a wing of Derceto Manor, invaded by a presence which appears to have emerged from the dark depths of the Bayou…
row.short_description: This stand-alone prologue puts you in the tiny shoes of Grace Saunders – an 11-year-old girl delivering a letter, when things go horribly wrong… Experience the unique 1920s horror atmosphere of Alone in the Dark and prepare for the terror that awaits in Derceto Manor
row.notes: Display of frightening monsters; jumpscares

row.name: DogeFight
row.detailed_description: DogeFight is an EPIC Third-Person Multiplayer Fighting game 👍 Play with the most incredible meme characters of all times like Stonks or Doge in a fun/competitive pvp game. More precisely, this game consists in surviving in a map with 10 other players, with a total of 3 lives. You have to be the last player alive by looting weapons and fighting your opponents until everybody lost their live's, and cannot respawn anymore. By winning a game, you will collect a huge amount of 'Social Credit', which allows you to be ranked in the online DogeFight leaderboard, with a specific rank according to your level. You can also gain social credit by collecting amogos coins in different maps, which you are able to keep if you survive at the end. This game is designed to play with friends in the same lobby, but it's also possible to play with randoms thanks to the server list. Be the best DogeFight player by mastering characters spells and climbing the ranks! Features Lobby system Up to 10 players in a game A wide variety of loot and weapons 9 Different characters with different attacks 6 unic maps based on memes Public Server List Ranking system with in-game leaderboard and ranks
row.short_description: DogeFight is an EPIC Third-Person Multiplayer Fighting game👍 Play with your favorite memes and be the last survivor by defeating your opponents with special abilites and weapons! But be careful not to be SUS 🗿
row.notes: Fights without gore or blood and with a cartoon style.

row.name: DEMoCap (Drag[en]gine Motion Capture)
row.detailed_description: DEMoCap allows to do Motion Capture using VR equipment for example for Game Development. There are various advantages to this technique compared to other MoCap techniques: Less expensive equipment Quick to equip actor for performing. Does not require large rooms build especially for MoCap. Allows actors to see the scene in which they have to perform. Capture motion in real time without post processing. Capture any count of characters and interactions between them no matter doing motion capture as single person or a group. Easily re-take captures of individual characters without re-taking all. Allows capturing complex characters (body, tails, wings, additional arms, u.s.f.) DEMoCap is build using the Drag[en]gine Game Engine. The resulting captured animations are usable directly in the Drag[en]gine Game Engine or can be imported into Blender3D for editing. Using Blender the captured animations can be used for everything Blender3D can be used for. DEMoCap uses the original armature/skeleton without modification. The captured animation is directly usable in-game. Using Motion Transfers DEMoCap supports various kinds of armatures/skeletons. You can capture humanoid characters, beastly characters, tails, wings, extra arms, and more. You can also capture First Person Hands for first person view oriented games. Using VR you can recreate the relevant parts of your game scene. This allows your actor to perform more natural and animations are better fitting to your game scene. Define precisely where your animation origins are located in-game. This ensures captured animations are properly positioned and oriented without the need to post-process them to fit into your game. In short DEMoCap accelerates the animation production allowing for higher quality animations to be done in less time. DEMoCap is Open Source. The GitHub repository link can be found at the home page. To use DEMoCap you need SteamVR and Drag[en]gine version 1.10 or higher. Links to tutorials and documentation can be found at the 'Online Manual' link in information box.
row.short_description: DEMoCap allows to do Motion Capture using VR equipment for example for Game Development.

row.name: Past Synergy
row.detailed_description: Past Synergy is a 2 player co-op game that tests you and your friend's synergy. Divide up the roles between you and your friends to overcome the obstacles in a cave. Avoid the dangerous traps and destroy fragile walls to open path to the next level. Bigger issue, however, may be your friend. If you step on your friend from above or shoot the fireball at your friend, you may need to restart the level. There are three abilities as of now. Shield: It makes the player immune to attacks Fireball: It can destroy fragile walls. Double jump: Helps your friend jump twice Each level features a unique challenge that will test you and your friend's current synergy. Besides the co-op mode, this game also features a pvp mode. Show your friend your true skill! Will your current synergy be stronger than the past synergy or will it be weaker?
row.short_description: Past Synergy is a 2 player co-op game that tests you and your friend's synergy. Divide the ability and roles between you and your friend to overcome the obstacles in a cave.

row.name: URUBU
row.detailed_description: URUBU is a Online Co-Op, payload & Gestion Elements. You play as recruits from the lastest division in their final test to join the ranks of Urubu. The Game was made in 10 weeks in the context of Ubisoft Game Lab Competition, and it won the jury's special award. To summarize the game, you need to destroy your environment to fuel your train, and bring it to the end of the level as soon as possible!
row.short_description: URUBU is a Online Co-Op, payload & Gestion Elements. You play as recruits from the lastest division in their final test to join the ranks of Urubu

row.name: Super SplashTube Bros.
row.detailed_description: A physics-based fighting game where the characters are disguised versions of some cool Brazilian YouTubers. Choose your favorite YouTuber and fight to show who's the greatest. This is a fighting game with 3D graphics but you can move in only two dimensions. It's super simple to play: just choose one out of the 8 available characters and go into a quest to beat all the others in their respective home arenas. To win a fight, simply push your opponent out of the arena. Features 8 amazing fighters (that you might know) 8 epic battle arenas A lot of ragdoll physics Super simple controls: just walk, jump and punch (a lot) Controls WASD keys to move F to punch (connect multiple attacks for combos) Hold F to block attacks Space bar to jump
row.short_description: An unusual battle between some cool YouTubers.

row.name: Hare Apparent
row.detailed_description: Hare Apparent is a dialogue-based roleplaying game in a high-stakes social elimination scenario. As one of five pretenders competing to rule the disparate kingdoms of Under-Sky, you’ll need all your social chops and strategic skills to be the last candidate standing and win the crown. During the day, talk with your fellow pretenders: build rapport, discuss issues, hatch plans and make false promises. Every night, votes are cast—and a pretender is eliminated. Last one standing wins the Ironwood Crown. Will it be you? • Randomized dialogue and relationships—no two playthroughs are the same. • 5 colorful and clever contenders to bond with or betray. • 6+ endings based on your cunning and conduct in the crucible of the Conclave. • Multiple difficulties to find that perfect balance between strategy and story.
row.short_description: An ancient custom is invoked, and five kingdoms send their young heirs to play a legendary game. Build relationships, form alliances, and win the crown in this high-stakes game of woodland politics and social maneuvering.

row.name: Paige Turner
row.detailed_description: Complete the story and reconnect a father and daughter! This is a game created by students at the University of Central Florida in the GaIM program. In this adventure, you'll travel through a magical library and enter storybooks in order to reconnect a father and daughter after tragedy tore them apart. Players take on the role of Auri, the healer of giants, an origami creature of unknown origin. Players will be able to transform into different forms in order to run and jump their way to the end of this story. This roughly 40-minute-long adventure lets you jump and glide your way over various puzzles over 5 different and varied levels. Players can expect to run up against some interesting platforming puzzles and narrative interludes. An environment with a story! Explore a library lost to time at the hands of grief and help heal the troubled keeper of the library, Turner, from the grief that ails him. The library holds the key to the source of Turner's anguish. Player's will be guided throughout the library by magic candles that have been imbued by some form of protective magic, leading you to the next piece of the story. Key Features Platforming and puzzling through 5 distinct and varied levels! A touching story about reconnection. Full controller support. 4 unique abilities to assist traversal! Fully voice-acted!
row.short_description: In this adventure, you'll travel through a magical library and platform your way through a library lost to time in order to reconnect a father and daughter after tragedy tore them apart. Utilize unique abilities to overcome the library's troublesome obstacles and unlock the pieces of the story!

row.name: 三国仁义传 the Romantic of Righteousness: SanGuo Playtest
Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League Playtest
Ellisar
row.detailed_description: Ellisar is an underwater adventure in a corrupted world. Your character will be able to explore the ocean using two kinds of bodies: a humanoid one and stingray-like one. With the help of your small but magic Mooty friends you will be able to soar through the devastated areas your species used to inhabit. Unique movement Your character can change its form to be able to move like a stingray. Using the magical power of the Mooties around you, you can flap your fins to impulse yourself forward. You can do this as many times as you have Mooties, but they have to rest, so you will need to transform back whenever their power has worn off. Contemplative exploration The world around you is both magical and devastated. While looking for the solution to the corruption, you will encounter many things that will shed a light to the history of your ancestors. A living environment Life finds a way. Even if everything around you seems hopeless, there's always life that can give you the push you need to continue. Our world is filled with small animals and algae that reminds the player of how necessary it is to continue this venture and prevent the disaster from spreading. Accessibility Features In CoGames we believe in the importance of accessibility, so we have certain features to make sure the game is playable by as many people as we can: Localization in many languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Danish, Basque and Catalan. And we might include more!! Control settings for one hand only Full control remapping HUD color customization
row.short_description: Dive into this magical underwater adventure. Explore a corrupted environment moving with your two transformations to help fix the disaster that almost ended life around your world. Ellisar is a third person contemplative exploration and adventure game.

row.name: Lonely Knight
row.detailed_description: Lonely Knight is an action-adventure game set in medieval and ancient times. You are playing as a hero whose name is Tristan. Tristan's former friend Garreth, seized his wife so he could return to the army. After capturing Nyneve, Tristan felt betrayed and decided to go on an unexpected journey through dangerous lands. World of betrayal Experience the action in a whole new light with Tristan's combat skills, and punish those who betrayed you. Be prepared to face deadly mythical monsters while avoiding perilous traps. Enter the chaos of war as a bold Knight and Interact with many unique and imaginative creatures and enemies. Forged in the flames of battles Battle across the dangerous lands against dragons, Skeletons, Demons, Ghosts, and a corrupted army in your quest for vengeance. Vanquish your foes using the game’s deep and intuitive combat system that is easy to learn. Fantastic graphics bring this mythical world to life. The defeat was merely delayed Arm yourself with brutal melee weapons, and jump into the Medieval world. Explore the world and defeat all of those who stand in your way. With the help of the God Zeus, show no mercy. Take to the field of battle and experience the brutality of medieval combat in a third-person perspective with hundreds of on-screen units, each with their own detailed AI. Key Features: Experience a lawless land Live an epic adventure through stunning landscapes. Dispense your own justice With a sword on your back, become a ruthless Knight. Epic Universe Unlike anything the player has seen before, take a look at a unique style. Freedom Explore the vast world and face various challenges – go solo and complete quests. Fantasy Explore lands inspired by medieval time including frosted mountaintops, deep forests, swamps, ruins, and caves, evacuated cities, deserts, and many more. Discover ancient secrets, seek forgotten treasures, and face mythical creatures inspired by medieval tales! Be part of an exciting story
row.short_description: Lonely Knight is a story that immerses you in an epic adventure in the medieval era. Avenge your wife as you battle invading forces, go on game-changing quests, and make influential choices. Fight in brutal battles where you will experience fast-paced combat, castle sieges, and more.

row.name: Tilebreaker
row.detailed_description: Destroy the blocks you achieve a 80% score while avoiding enemies and their attacks. Improve your time and unlock additional levels!. 20 unique levels and 5 bosses with different techniques to challenge you! Hi, I'm Nicolas Rizzi, just a guy who loves making games. 'TileBreaker' was my first creation; it's a bit rough around the edges, but filled with passion and fun gameplay. I poured a lot of love into it, learning and growing along the way. I truly hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it. If you do, feel free to check out my other works. Here's to more gaming adventures together!
row.short_description: Destroy blocks through 20 levels and 5 unique bosses with different mechanics. Do it in the best possible time!

row.name: Cool People Club
row.detailed_description: Cool People Club is a 3D Bullet Hell Adventure. STORY Plate, Duck, and Sock come across a Cool Contest - a contest in which the winner is granted a wish. However, the winner of this contest is determined by combat, and our heroes might just be in over their heads. Are you cool enough to lead them to victory? Choose your fate...

row.name: 斩魔问道
row.detailed_description: 游戏中讲述了一位从小在茅山派学道多年的弟子，听闻遥远村落中出现狐妖残害百姓的诡异事件，决心离开道观，入世调查，为百姓排忧解难。调查途中，他遇到了入世修行多年的师门前辈林九叔，在他的指点下巧妙应对各种危机。鬼怪猖狂，真相扑朔迷离，主角抽丝剥茧，不曾想，千年狐妖竟是…… 主角虽是初出道观，却意志坚定、心怀天下，在经历了诸多可怕的事件后，仍心系百姓，不忘初衷。赶尸、冥婚、招魂、蛊毒、碟仙……鬼怪可怖，人心更甚。在入世目睹了种种人间悲剧后，主角决心剿灭狐妖、铲除鬼怪，破除陋习，在风云动荡的乱世中，尽全力保护百姓安全。 游戏采用即时战斗模式。
row.short_description: 在游戏中，民间传说化为可视化的现实，玩家通过主角的视角经历各种民俗异闻，通过完成任务、剧情探索、击败尸王、挑战副本、日常活动等玩法获取各种材料和资源，用以提升装备、获取坐骑、收集异宠，强力变身，以此来提升自己的战斗力，从各路邪魔鬼怪的威胁下保护百姓，缔造了一个充满人间正气的世界。通过游戏，让玩家了解更多民间传说和民俗文化，并培养了玩家积极进取和团队协作精神。

row.name: Pico Link
row.detailed_description: Pico Link is a software that allows users to connect VR devices to computers to play games. If you have got a Pico VR device, you can quickly connect to the computer through this software, and configure the streaming options on the computer. Start to experience the exciting game content, the software interface is simple, the device connection process is displayed, you can connect to the device through 5G routing or DP cable. Software functions are still very simple, and detailed tutorials are also attached, allowing users to quickly configure VR devices to play games. There're several points you should know: 1、Pico Link only supports Pico VR devices , but not any other VR headset 2、When you choose DP link mode on this Pico VR devices, you should download and install this 'Pico Link' App first.
row.short_description: Pico Link is a software that allows users to connect VR devices to computers to play games. If you have got a Pico VR device, you can quickly connect to the computer through this software, and configure the streaming options on the computer.

row.name: The Nameless Braves: Heaven (Episode 1)

Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as 'The Dark Age', one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero. You will follow the story of Elijah, a rookie member of a mercenary organization known as 'The Braves'. The lands of Ankh-Seah are wrought with dangers both human and inhuman. Elijah and his allies will be pit against the various threats that creep in the shadows of Ankh-Seah, uncovering secrets while being forced to confront harsh truths about their world and even themselves. Format The Nameless Braves is planned, at current, to be a trilogy of sorts. The first book is The Nameless Braves: Heaven. It is planned to have four episodes, and this first one is free!
row.short_description: The Nameless Braves is a kinetic-style Visual Novel. Set in the fantasy continent of Ankh-Seah during a dour era referred to as 'The Dark Age', one young man strives through trials and heartbreak to accomplish his dream of becoming a hero.

row.name: Zumbi Blocks 2 Open Alpha
row.detailed_description: Zumbi Blocks 2 Zumbi Blocks 2 is a zombie survival game. It's going to be available for free while it's in early development. Much will change in terms of gameplay, as it will move towards a base building / wave survival type of game. Kill: fight zombies with melee and ranged weapons, both in first person or third person mode. Loot: explore the procedurally generated city , to find resources. row.name: Nero Score - PC benchmark & performance test
row.detailed_description: Nero Score  - The real-world PC benchmark Nero Score is a free tool which measures your processor’s (CPU) multi-core power and is pushing your graphics card (GPU) to it’s maximum limit with real world multimedia use cases. Nero Score is used by journalists to review hardware, hardware manufacturers to optimize their latest products, as well as computer owners to evaluate their individual system to make purchase decisions. WHAT KIND OF BENCHMARKS ARE INCLUDED IN NERO SCORE? *Now Nero Score includes Metaverse benchmark with 3D real-time rendering test on GPU.* Nero Score includes AI Tagging test and AVC Decoding and Encoding tests. AI Tagging test will generate a CPU AI benchmark and measures how many pictures per second can be processed with artificial intelligence on the given CPU. So this is not about training an model, but actually applying a trained model on data (called inference). The outcome of this test will let you compare how different CPUs score in this domain. The result can be 1:1 matched with CPU-based AI inference solution, like e.g. Nero AI Photo Tagger. The data set for this test includes 50 pictures that will be inferred 3 times each. The format and size of the pictures doesn’t matter for this test as the AI inference only needs an input of 299×299 pixels in size anyway. AVC Decoding and Encoding test will generate a CPU AVC benchmark and a GPU AVC benchmark. AVC test measures how many frames per second can be processed with system AVC decoding and encoding on the given CPU and GPU. The result can be 1:1 matched with system AVC solution, like e.g. Nero MKV Converter, Windows Movies & TV, etc. HOW IS THE SCORE CALCULATED? Nero is fully transparency on the calculation of the actual score. Each of the tests executed within Nero Score will generate a score of it’s own. For example: The CPU AI benchmark measures how many pictures are processed per second. This number is multiplied by a factor of 25 to generate the score for this specific test. So there is a 1:1 relation between the score and the performance of the CPU for the given task. A PC with twice the score will be twice as fast. As soon as there are more tests a total score will be calculated from the single results and the simple formula for this calculation will be made transparent, too. Over time there might be changes on how the score is calculated, those will be called out and documented with revisions to ensure that results are always reproducible and comparable. HOW CAN I CHECK MORE REAL-WORLD PERFORMANCE DATA? score.nero.com will list all performance data which submitted by customers. Try Nero Score on your PC now, to see how your PC performs. WHAT SHOULD BE CONSIDERED BEFORE/WHILE RUNNING A TEST? • Laptops should be connected to a power supply. • The high performance power plan should be selected on any device. • All open applications should be closed. • No user activity should be done in the foreground. • Background activity should be avoided e.g. no virus scans, software update downloads, cloud uploads. WHICH KIND OF PLATFORMS ARE SUPPORTED BY NERO SCORE? At the moment Nero Score is supporting Windows 10/11 64-Bit exclusively.

row.detailed_description: Controller Support The Anointed supports most XBox controllers and is compatible with SteamDeck. About the Game You are David, a young shepherd boy that quickly realizes he has a greater purpose than just taking care of sheep. With wisdom, skill and bravery, you will progress through many events and locations from the biblical stories of young David. The Anointed: David Saves Keilah is a single-player, action-adventure game with platforming elements experienced in 3rd-person perspective. This is a demo of the larger game, The Anointed: Heart of David - due to be released in late 2026. In DSK, David traverses many locations; moving through the wilderness of Ziph, the Forest of Hereth, and the threshing floors and stronghold of Ancient Keilah, all in this single episode (1 Sam 23). As David, the player has the physical ability to walk, crawl, crouch, sprint, jump, vault over objects, climb on buildings, scale up walls, swing from ropes, and there is even a horse for those long runs through the wilderness. Although the story is linear, there are plenty of things to discover and many paths to take to fulfill each part of David's mission to save Keilah. There is a vast open-world feel with no time limits between objectives. There are loud thunderstorms and bright sunny skies, and David has a torch to light his way inside dark rooms/areas. Dialogues and Scrolls of information (Scripture) help guide David on the right path, while providing invaluable lessons. And, there are videos (Prayer Tips) that help the player navigate the challenges ahead. David's sling, staff, sword and spear are very useful weapons against the Philistines, the wild animals, and all the enemies of David - but Stealth and patience can be the most rewarding strategy. The Vitality, Righteousness, and Empowerment meters reflect the state of David during gameplay. All of these elements and features come together in an exciting version of the biblical narrative of David, God's Anointed.
