Your first task will be to restore the museum you inherited from your grandfather, restore its glory and compete for the admiration of critics and visitors! RENEW MUSEUM - before you renovate the museum, do a demolition job ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── RESTORE ARTEFACTS - get and restore artifacts in your professional studio, feel like a real restorer ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── EXPLORE UNKNOWN PLACES - Visit interesting places and get exhibits for the museum yourself Piramid will be available in prologue version Bunker will be available in full version ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── MAINTAIN THE BUILDING - clean and renovate the old museum, remember that a beautiful place requires constant work ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ORGANIZE EXHIBITIONS - show what you have created and organized the best exhibitions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── Restore your way to glory! - breathe new life into an old museum building - explore unknow places and aquire the artifacts - collect old and damaged artefacts - explor remote world corners and find exhibits - solve the riddles - restore antiques and make them regain their shine - create the best exhibition - organise auctions and earn - become the largest art institution This groundbreaking, cross genre title lets you become a STAR in the Museum industry. You will be facing tough managerial decisions, financial struggles and a traps lurking for you during the expeditions Do you think you have what it takes to create the best exhibition in the country? Are you ready to get dirty, to find the most unique artefact on the market? Will you make HISTORY?
row.short_description: Welcome to the exciting world of My Museum! Experience the adventure of your life and get the exhibits. Use your talents to restore ancient artefacts! Build the greatest exhibition of all time! Will you become a part of HISTORY?

row.name: Run N' Gun
row.detailed_description: Skate and shoot your way through waves of enemies increasing your firepower along the way to become the champion. Run N' Gun is a First-person arcade shooter with a focus on movement. Become the Protagonist Bot and use your skills to survive waves of Antagonist Bots to win it all. Stadiums Gain speed, explore, gear up and shoot through waves of Antagenst Bots. Choose one of two locations to become the champion and prove to them all, that there is only one Protagonist. The Arena is set in the dead of night on top of a building in the Bot's new capital city. Design for movement this stadium sets the new standard for speed and versatility. The Facility is set in a part of this world long forgotten. With tight corners and roofs, one's ability to aim will be their best friend. Guns & Augments Pick up the tools for the job and enhance your ability by using five different unique weapons and six augments. Use the Assault Rifle, Shotgun, Sniper, Pistol, or Greatsword to slay the Antagonist Bots where they stand. Become More powerful to defeat your foes using Augments. enhancing the Protagonist's physical prowess and weapon behavior. Antagonist Bots Run from and defeat four top-of-the-line Antaginest Bots why they seek the Protagonists Bot out and end his career to become the champion. Drones, why weak will try to swarm you and overpower you with numbers and air power. Walkers, the calvary of the Antaginest Bots seek you out and will outmaneuver you when they fire their deadly weapons. Trappers, avoiding the Protagonists while still being a menace.
row.short_description: Skate and shoot your way through waves of enemies increasing your firepower along the way to become the champion. Run N' Gun is a First-person arcade shooter with a focus on movement. Become the Protagonist Bot and use your skills to survive waves of Antagonist Bots to win it all.
row.notes: Players shoot and destroy robots resulting in explosions. Robots will also say satirical voice lines.

row.name: Oceans
row.detailed_description: Enter a vast, underwater cosmos: a mysterious interconnected world of tentacles, sharp teeth, and black ink, where your survival depends on your ability to adapt in a continually changing environment. But this is just on the surface… Lurking below the surface lie mysteries so bizarre they hardly seem natural. The Deep is a deck of mysterious traits you’ll discover over the course of many games. These over-powered traits represent the unknown: the undiscovered wonders of the deep ocean. Buy once, play on any platform! Based on the hit board game, Oceans offers a beautifully crafted strategy game experience. The reef and 20 deep cards are completely free to play (and ad-free!), and you may also join one multiplayer game per day free. A one-time upgrade to the Complete Game features 87 Deep Cards, 21 Scenarios, and multiple hard AI personalities for endless replay fun. You can also play unlimited online games against others on any platform, in real time or asynchronously, create your own multiplayer games, and even create your own decks for use in singleplayer and multiplayer. You are also able to login with your account on mobile platforms and unlock your purchased functionality there. Venture into the deep at your own risk!
row.short_description: Adapt your Species to survive and thrive in the Oceans depths in this turn-based strategy game based on the hit board game Oceans.

row.name: World of Mines Creator's Edition
row.detailed_description: Dive into World of Mines Creator’s Edition — where classic Minesweeper meets limitless pixel-art creativity. Build your own pixel artworks with an intuitive in-game editor, then instantly transform them into playable, hand-crafted Minesweeper puzzles. Play over 600 community-created levels, discover new pixel challenges every week, and share your creations through Steam Workshop. Whether you love logic puzzles, pixel art, or the nostalgia of Minesweeper, World of Mines turns creativity into gameplay. Create Design pixel art from scratch using a simple grid editor. Every pixel becomes a tile — place, paint, and sculpt your image into a custom puzzle. Play Test your creations or explore a growing library of player-made levels, from meme art and retro icons to detailed illustrations and themed puzzle packs. Share Publish your artwork in the Steam Workshop with one click. Browse, rate, and save designs from players around the world. Features • Pixel art editor → instantly converts art into Minesweeper puzzles • 600+ community puzzle levels and growing daily • Unique challenge themes: retro, memes, art, logic, abstract • Endless creativity through Steam Workshop • Relaxing design, challenging gameplay • Beginner-friendly creation tools • Classic Minesweeper rules reimagined with art • Support for 27+ languages How to Play Each pixel may hide a mine. Numbers show how many mines surround a tile. Mark suspected mines with a flag, reveal safe tiles, and uncover the full artwork without detonating a bomb. Unleash your creativity, test your logic, and join a community reshaping Minesweeper one pixel at a time.
row.short_description: Classic Minesweeper meets pixel art creativity! Craft unique pixel puzzles, transform them into challenging minesweeper levels, and explore endless community creations.

row.name: Cyphers Game
row.detailed_description: DISCOVER THE DEEPEST MYSTERIES OF ESPIONAGE AND FEEL THE RUSH OF VICTORY Take the role of soldiers, cryptologists, and communication experts during the Polish-Bolshevik War of 1920! Operate historical communication devices, decode enemy ciphers, and gain access to secret information that shaped the outcome of the war. Discover the inner workings of Bolshevik armored trains and participate in crucial missions that led to Poland’s victory. Every aspect of the game has been meticulously crafted with the help of source materials or accurately replicated from historical exhibits. Players engage in documented historical events, with each character assigned a unique, vital role in determining the battle’s outcome. Key Features: A captivating story inspired by real events and featuring authentic Polish cryptographers and soldiers from the Polish-Bolshevik War Elements of stealth, cryptographic puzzles, and interaction with historical communication devices Attention to historical detail, with all devices and elements in the game carefully recreated from source materials and historical artifacts Gameplay that blends action, puzzle-solving, and exploration, offering a unique combination of education and entertainment in a three-dimensional space
row.short_description: It is the end of 1920. The Polish-Bolshevik war has been going on for almost two years. The battle for Korosteń – a key railway junction and technical supply base – is underway. Break Bolshevik cyphers, ensure radio communication, and neutralise the fearsome armoured trains.

row.name: Boxel Golf
row.detailed_description: Boxel Golf is a multiplayer golf game packed with challenging courses, custom hats, and a powerful level builder. Features: - Online multiplayer - Over 50 levels - Golf cart Racing - Hat shop - Level Builder - Music maker No internet? No problem. Play offline to beat your high scores and earn rewards. The Level Builder has been reinvented from scratch, and is now easier than ever to use. Simply draw anywhere on the screen and instantly play your beautiful creation. Make levels that are unique to your play-style, or create impossible levels for your friends.
row.short_description: Boxel Golf is a multiplayer golf game packed with challenging courses, custom hats, and a powerful level builder.

row.name: Minion Raid: Epic Monsters
row.detailed_description: Experience epic minion adventures as a trainer in the dungeon You have the power over many little minions - train them to become unbeatable fighting machines and take the scepter in your hands! The monsters of the underworld are looking for a new overlord, but the selection in the dungeon is hard... To leave the arena victorious, you need well-trained minions with special abilities. They also acquire them through evolution. Your trainer skills also play a role: the better you are as a drill instructor, the more dangerous your troops will be in battle. Attack is the best defense: Choose a suitable battle strategy! Depending on the training session and the type of minions, they have different fighting abilities. Some are stronger in attack, some are better in defense. Accordingly, you need a clever battle strategy. Choose the attacking minions for the front lines and the minions with a longer range for the back lines. It's also helpful if you know the strengths and weaknesses of your opponents in the dungeon and choose your battle lineup accordingly. Before facing the competition in epic battles, you can try out your minion squad in test campaigns. But if your lineup is suitable, you can also send your minions directly into the arena for the first PvE battle. Let's see how good your training was... There are also tournaments in this idle fighting game - those are fought in PvP mode. Winning the arena will bring you not only higher prestige, but also gold and a better ranking in the league. If you still don't get enough of battling in the dungeon, then create a guild and work together with other guild members to make fat loot. Fame, glory and gold make you an overlord Your mission in this idle fighting game is to seize the power in the dungeon. You'll achieve this by preparing your minions well for battle. As a trainer, you should also advance your own skills. To do this, you'll use the gold you collect through victories in the arena. Idle missions in the tavern also bring you gold. You can use it to upgrade your trainer skills and those of your minions. Afterwards, you fight your way across the dungeon on a map and encounter different enemies. Use your captured resources wisely while training your minions and you'll soon be able to rule over the monsters of the underworld.
row.short_description: Conquer a dungeon as a minion trainer - become the hero of the arena!

row.name: Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite
row.detailed_description: If you like jigsaw puzzles - this is your game. Sit back, relax and build puzzles to your heart's content. What you get with Jigsaw Puzzle Infinite: Infinite possibilities  - Choose from one of the dozens of included puzzles or add your own images without any limits Classic mode - Jigsaw puzzles you know and love. Take your time and build the puzzle with the help of useful sorting features Sorting - Sort pieces by section, sort out edges, or just spread them out neatly Zen Mode - Enter the flow and assemble the puzzle piece by piece Different piece shapes - Choose from multiple possible shapes of the pieces Every puzzle unique - Pieces are randomized each time new puzzle is generated No microtransactions - Enjoy the puzzles up to 200 pieces or unlock all current and future content with a single purchase
row.short_description: Sit back, relax and build puzzles to your heart's content. Assemble one of the many included puzzles, or add your own images. Customize size and shape of the pieces for any puzzle. Enjoy Classic mode or try out Zen mode for a new type of puzzle experience.

row.name: Alexandria - Port of Worlds
row.detailed_description: Cannes XR and NewImages Festival are proud to announce the launch of Alexandria, a new futuristic virtual world showcasing the best of international VR creation and designed to host immersive events throughout the year! 🕶️🌐🕶️ Developed and designed by Kreis Immersive, Alexandria will open in May and feature more than 30 new VR works, including those from our Cannes XR exhibition.
row.short_description: Cannes XR and NewImages Festival are proud to announce the launch of Alexandria, a new futuristic virtual world showcasing the best of international VR creation and designed to host immersive events throughout the year! 🕶️🌐🕶️

row.name: Masks Of Deception
row.detailed_description: Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... or the demon will slay you first. You’ve been sent to disrupt and purge a demon before it claims three lives and fulfills its ritual. Purgers (innocents) must be cautious in performing their task as the demon isn’t the only one looking to slay them. Others silently patrol searching for victims outside ultraviolet protection, and some will attack only if you prompt them to. As a Purger you’ll be traveling around the entire area looking for paranormal zones to investigate, making progress towards uncovering the Demon’s type. These zones appear and disappear in different locations as time goes on. While searching it can be easy to lose sight of teammates, offering the Demon an opportunity to perform a suspicious action. Trust must be earned and even then isn’t a guarantee. Keep everyone at an arm's reach until you can confirm they are who they claim to be. For every three demon books the Demon collects and deposits on a summoning circle they’ll be able to kill one Purger. As your party dwindles the Demon’s identity will likely be exposed if you haven’t learned who it was already. Time is of the essence to figure out the Demon’s type, with both uncovered you can vote and cast the incantation to exorcize the Demon. Performed correctly the Demon will be purged from this world and the Purgers will win. However if the vote is cast incorrectly the Purgers will lose and the Demon will be freed. One chance is all you get, make it count. Falling victim to one of the threats or the Demon isn’t the end. After death you respawn as a Ghost with separate tasks of destroying Demon Books and collecting Sacred Pages scattered around the area. If you manage to collect all 10 Sacred Pages and turn them in you and the Purgers will exorcize the Demon.
row.short_description: Masks of Deception is a 6 player horror game where you must use teamwork, equipment, and sensing abilities to identify then exorcize the demon in your group... otherwise the demon will slay you first.

row.name: F.I.D.O.
row.detailed_description: FIDO is a short, top down horror game about a dogsitter's job gone wrong. Walk around three different stages, complete dogsitter tasks, and avoid Fido. To win, you must translate demon runes to fend off Fido while collecting the items needed to exorcise the dog! Just a quick little indie game made for class :) Features (Potential Spoilers): - Three different stages of the game - Different goals and mechanics for each stage - Fetch Quests and 'stealth' section - Exploration and discovery - Unique 'Translation' mechanic (translate runes flying at you to keyboard letters, and press them all in time to keep Fido at bay) - Roughly 15-30min playtime - A main menu
row.short_description: Follow the very unique premise of an indie horror game about a demo-.... ok maybe not so unique, but we have a dog so there's that.

row.name: Five Stages of Pink
row.detailed_description: Follow the overwhelming life of Timor who desperately tries to find some Normalcy in a very supernatural city where the color pink is forbidden because of its dark history. Timor is a teenager and teenagers suffer from high curiosity. You will help him elucidate Septeek city's many hidden mysteries and dark past while trying to not get kidnapped (and killed?) a third time because of reasons he doesn't even know (yet). In a universe where Sleep is an illness and Timor has to deal with it. This game has : - A 'Complete your Journal' task that encourages the player to investigate everything about the characters and the mysteries around them. - A very large cast of +20 main characters with rich stories. - Deep family dramas and friendship struggles. - But also lots of wholesome family and friendship love. - Freedom time in the day where the player can move around in the vast choices of settings and choose with who or what to interact with. - Meaning : multiple side story tangents but following one big main plot. This is an episodic visual novel with point and click features. The gameplay is there to accompany the story and not the other way around. Chapter 0 is Free !
row.short_description: Horror mystery about a boy who desperately wants a Normal life in the most abnormal city in the world. Help Timor understand his cruel life in this supernatural city while trying to survive one more day. In a universe where Sleep is an illness. This is a visual novel with point and click features.
row.notes: This game contains LIGHT horror elements that can disturb those that are very sensible. Things like corpses, torture through poisoning, slight gore, light jumpscares (not your 'jump at you with a very loud sound' jumpscares, I don't like those), violent scenes, mentions of child abuse and many horror/dark themes that are not suitable for children under 13. This game also contains depictions of depression and suicidal characters.

row.name: Moonstuck
row.detailed_description: You’re far from home and you’re all alone, but there’s some soothing music keeping you going and your mood is pretty high. You just have to get off this rock. You are Moonstuck. An intriguing hybrid of ‘rage game’ and chill, wholesome experience, Moonstuck will push you to your limits of endurance, but keep your mind centered and relaxed the entire time. Navigate a huge winding labyrinth of traps and hazards in the safety of your little ship by delicately bouncing your boosts and directions until you’re free. Your boosters won't last forever, so you'll need to carefully and consistently shift a little bit here and there to make your way through. You can do it though, it's fine. With checkpoints, a calm atmosphere and a pastel colour palette, Moonstuck is designed for you to succeed, if only you have the patience. The entire game is available for free, so the only thing you need to spend is your time. Try it out, and see how this strange experiment into the chill, relaxing rage game subgenre plays out for you. See if you can get home. See if you can escape from being Moonstuck . - One-button platform gameplay that is easy to pick up yet hard to master - A soothing chill lo-fi soundtrack that'll keep your mood stabilised as you try and get 'unstuck' - Carefully placed checkpoints so that nothing ever gets too much for you - A rocky terrain in a far off land for you to float, jet and fly through - Hazards and landmarks that will challenge your ability to keep flying - A unique hybrid 2D platforming arcade style between rage game and chill-'em-up - An immediate restart so you won't get too angry - Kinda like the rage games you've played before ( Getting Over It, Jump King ) but way more relaxing - Tough but addictive gameplay - Entirely free!
row.short_description: Relaxing rage game in a cutesy wholesome Moonstuck land. Delicate jump-balancing rage platformer where your job is to escape, while staying relaxed.

row.name: Planet S
row.detailed_description: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction. The world consists of up to 24 procedurally generated planets which you can colonize. A planets type affects things like the appearance, the farm productivity and the kind of resources you can find on it. You start the game with a spaceship and enough materials to colonize your first planet. Uncolonized planets can be claimed by building a spaceport on it. Once you claimed a planet, you can integrate it into your economy! To advance your faction and unlock new buildings you need to attract residents and provide them the goods they require. By gaining more and more residents, you will unlock new production chains which will increase in complexity. At some point, your first planet won't be able to supply you with the resources you need, so you need to expand to other planets. While you start your population with workers, you need to make a decision when you advance to the second tier. You can upgrade your residents to the science or military civilization type. You can adjust the direction in an adjacent city center. Your decision will determine your path for the game and set a focus on either a more peacefully or a violent way of playing and winning the game. It may be rational to carefully consider your decision and adapt to the situation you are in. Residents of a civilization type generate either science or military research points, which you can invest into research. The two research trees unlock bonuses and unique buildings for the corresponding civilization type. Through that, the game experience will rely heavily on the path you select. You can play alone or with up to seven friends. You can either practice diplomacy and negotiate agreements, or act militarily against each other. Coupled with the fact that each player can build his civilization differently, every game remains exciting.
row.short_description: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction.

row.name: Frostbitten
row.detailed_description: You're ending the day at your assigned post when you receive a call from the chief ranger. A colleague, and friend, who is stationed in a nearby sector has failed to report back for a day or so... You are requested to investigate his whereabouts only to find his ranger station in disarray, with no one left in sight. You then venture into the snow-ridden forest, dread setting in, as you realize something is amiss... Be the Ranger Make your way through the forest as Thomas, a park ranger for White Valley National Park, as a strange presence lurks among the trees. Survive the night equipped only with a flashlight, shovel, and lighter. Immerse Yourself Experience the isolation, paranoia, and mysterious air of a dark, winter forest alive with the sounds of night. Strategize Your Escape Use your shovel to create barriers between you and your impending death, but whatever you do, don't stare at it for too long. Explore the Park With a flashlight as your guiding light, discover the clues that will bring you closer to the truth. NOTE: This game is in its open Beta phase and is the product of a student development team . We are very appreciative of everyone who takes the time to play our game and welcome the feedback!
row.short_description: Frostbitten takes you into the depths of a national park's snow-ridden forest; a place notorious for consuming those who enter. Through the eyes of a park ranger in this survival horror experience, discover the dark secrets that lie beyond the clearing…
row.notes: This game contains some profanity and fantasy-related violence.

row.name: Sleep Paralysis: The Uncanny Valley Playtest
Albert Innovation
row.detailed_description: Albert Innovation, a company known for its extraordinary technological innovations, offers you a job. But when you arrive, no one is there to greet you... you realize you are on your own to find the mysterious boss Albert Thompson. Through the deserted premises, interact with special devices developed by former engineers to explore the premises and try to uncover the company's disturbing past. But beware, because you are not alone in this place... Hand-drawn monochrome 3D graphics creating a dark and unique. An immersive audio universe composed by Virgil Marrel Astonishing devices to hold in your hand to progress There is a threat to you and to these places... This is the Albert Innovation demo, then once the game is released in its entirety, it will be paid for. -Delirium Den
row.short_description: Albert Innovation is an immersive, narrative, atmospheric semi-horror game, where you will attempt to unravel the mysteries of what was once the most brilliant technological innovation company of the olden days. Manipulate machines, run away, and put an end to this nightmare.

row.name: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game
row.detailed_description: Cards Building You will draw a lot of cards on the path of cultivation. You need to choose the appropriate cards from them and build your deck. Exert biggest power of your cards by combining and collocating them. Sub-Profession In each game, you can choose a Sub-Profession. Each Sub-Profession has a set of exclusive cards. The same character can build different deck by matching different Sub-Profession, and obtain different game experiences. The mechanism of Character plus Sub-Profession can greatly increases the playability. Immortal Fates Immortal Fate is the gift of fate that the character receives on the path of cultivation. Every time you break through, multiple Immortal Fates will appear randomly according to the sect and character you choose. You need to choose your Immortal Fate. The effects of Immortal Fates are various, including card drawing, attribute increasing, and various passive effects, etc. Some Destines even require you to build a deck according to their effects. Fortunes On the path to cultivation, fortunes are also a part of strength. After each battle, there is a very small chance to encounter an fortune card. Through fortune cards, you can get Spiritual Pet cards, Talisman cards and Guild Secret Spell cards. These cards are very rare, and their strength may be similar to the regular cards of the same rank, but they often bring you new building ideas and help you create unique and rare decks. Battle with Other Players Each of your opponents are other players online, and everyone builds a deck from scratch. Every battle with your opponent will test your deck’s strength, and you will be eliminated if you lose multiple battles. Devise strategies, climb to the top of cultivation, and wait for you to battle!
row.short_description: Yi Xian: The Cultivation Card Game is an online DBG which contains a PVE mode called Uncharted Realms and a PVP mode. Every game is a deck building from scratch. Players can have stronger decks by changing cards, and then build more powerful routines to defeat all opponents to win.

row.name: Nocturama
row.detailed_description: Nocturama Bononia [/] is a container of interactive comics of the urban fantasy genre, set in a nocturnal Bologna. The stories are linked to places, monuments and city objects, located on a map of Bologna, and tell of different characters but with a single common denominator: living the most important night of one's existence [/]. Liber Paradisus[/] [/h2] 'This is the memorial of the male and female servants who were freed by the Municipality of Bologna ...' [/] Red has been in Italy for some time and is a rider. He is very tired from the continuous work. Called back by the company several times, he is forced to suffer and move forward, for himself and his family. There is someone who is waiting for him for the umpteenth delivery, a man who recites the memorial known as the Book of Paradise. And he seems really looking forward to meeting his rider. Ars Memoriae [/] [/] What are you willing to risk for a great story? [/] A narrator has lost all inspiration and wanders through the streets of Bologna under the moonlight. Entering the historic University Library, he finds a hooded figure who promises to help him if he will play a strange game, with a worn-out tarot deck. Gargoyle [/] [/] Son of Good. O Son of Evil. Without knowing where one or the other is. [/] A man wanders aimlessly after drinking all night, gripped by pain. When he finds a street corner where Good and Evil coexist, he will have to accept this paradox. And confront his demons. A seamstress' night[/] [/] One obsession: that your art is never forgotten. [/] After winning the most important tailoring award, Roberta was torn apart by critics. Obsessed with her work, she cut off every other relationship. The only leisure she allows herself is to spend a few minutes in the cloister of the Church of Santo Stefano, at the end of her working day. Here, one night, she finds a woman who proposes a pact to make her art immortal. The Wanderer[/] [/] The ultimate recipe for the control of souls, an inheritance at hand. And only a guy who can stop you. [/] Dasein is the last descendant of an ancient Academia, formed by the nobles who studied at the University of Bologna in the Archiginnasio. Here they accumulated the many ingredients needed to prepare Theriaca, an elixir to control human souls. And Dasein has only one obstacle to overcome to reach his inheritance: a boy. The Wanderer. Emma [/] [/] Emma is thirteen years old and has gotten lost in the large park of Villa Angeletti. As she searches her way home, she finds the macabre remains of previous visitors to the park, until she gets close to the banks of the Navile Canal. Here she discovers where those remains came from, and what lies hidden in the waters of the Canal. Requiescat [/] [/] Even if you are infallible, there are always those who will prove the opposite to you. Whether it is corporeal or not. [/] Dalia has been hunting ectoplasms for more than twenty years, and no ghost has ever deceived her. You receive a letter, a request for help from the ancient Villa Clara, just outside the city. The Slayer is suspicious, no one sends such letters anymore. And once she reaches the Villa she discovers that her suspicions are well founded. Perhaps she, for the first time, she was really deceived. Two soloists A promising pianist, a ruthless killer. Two soloists. Carlo, an acclaimed pianist, is about to debut at the Teatro Comunale. When he starts to play, each of his chords corresponds to a crime in the alleys of Bologna, carried out by a heinous murderer. Neither Carlo nor the murderer are able to stop: both are desperately seeking the applause of their audiences. Kairos What if Bologna is one of the Pillars of Time? Proarke and Sige are the two Guardians of Kairos, the temporal dimension, and have been resting for centuries, petrified in the form of Eagles set in the facade of Palazzo d'Accursio. But as the sundials and clocks of Bologna begin to melt, they awaken to try to understand who is endangering time. They discover that the cause has to do with their past, and with ancient, unsolved jealousies.
row.short_description: Nocturama Bononia is a container of interactive comics, of an urban fantasy genre, set in a nocturnal Bologna. Different stories and characters but with a single common denominator: living the most important night of one's existence.

row.name: Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea
row.detailed_description: “Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea” is a free-to-play, MMO shooting game. As a navy commander, you may choose 6 types of warships used in the World War II to fight the 16vs16 battles. Start the voyage with your warships and fight for the honor of your fleet! game Features: Essence of team play: Tactics first 6 warship types and over 100 famous warships with distinctive features. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea presents the 6 most representative warships of the modern and contemporary naval system, namely, destroyer, light cruiser, heavy cruiser, battleship, carrier, and particularly the “deep sea killer” – submarine, appearing for the first time. Deep Sea Assassin - D-Class Submarine Attacks. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea presents the nightmare of Atlantic ships for all captains, the famous deep-sea assassin - D-series submarine! German submarines with enhanced underwater speed, underwater endurance and torpedo loading capabilities have better lighting efficiency and a safer output environment. At this point, the complete lineup of wolves that the German Navy is proud of has officially debuted, and the fiery scene of wolves fighting will be particularly spectacular. The following is an introduction to the basic information of D-series submarines. Captains who like to play submarines can do their homework in advance： U-IIA (D series 2-class submarine): On the day when the Anglo-German naval agreement was passed, the new German submarine U-1 was officially launched. The new submarine is called Type 2A (Tpye IIA), which is mainly used for submarine crews. train and test. Due to their small tonnage, these submarines seldom conduct far-sea operations. U-VIIA (Class 3 submarine of D series): Type 7A is the basic prototype of Type 7 submarine. It is a new generation of medium-sized attack submarines built by the German Navy after World War I. This type of submarine was designed in 1933 and its main technology is based on World War I. The Type 3 submarine was improved. The performance of the Type 7 submarine is very good, and the diving speed is very good. U-VIIC (D series 4-class submarine): The 7C type is the most productive type of the 7-type submarine, and it is also one of the main submarines of the German submarine force during World War II. This type of boat is slightly longer than the 7B type, but does not improve the performance of the main engine, so the speed is reduced. U-VIIF (D class 5 submarine): As the threat of Allied aircraft to the submarine force was increasing, Germany thought of strengthening the submarine's air defense to counter the threat of air strikes. Some Type 7C submarines were converted into dedicated anti-aircraft submarines (U-Flak). These conversions added two to three quadruple 20mm anti-aircraft machine guns to the submarine, and experimentally added 37mm anti-aircraft guns. Anti-aircraft artillery, torpedo reserves were reduced. U-IXA (D series 6-level submarine): The 9A submarine was designed as the basic type of the 9-type submarine in 1935. It refers to the Type 1 submarine developed after the First World War. Its combat goal is to focus on ocean-going operations. The fuel tank and the torpedo attack capability were strengthened. U-IXC (D-Series 7th-class submarine): The 9C type adds an additional 43 tons of fuel tanks on the basis of its basic model, which further expands the sailing range. This series also removes the second periscope in the control room. In order to perform mine-laying tasks, the Type 9C also has additional mine chambers. U-IXD-2 (Class 8 submarine of the D series): Type 9D is the largest model among Type 9 submarines. The entire Type 9D is divided into 3 types due to different power systems. Type 9D2 is mainly based on Type 9D1. Its unreliable powertrain has been corrected. U-XXI (D series 9-class submarine): Type 21 is one of the new high-speed submarines developed by the German Navy during World War II. The boat was designed to increase the underwater speed as the main goal. Therefore, the shape and structure of the boat The design is very simple and streamlined, removing the useless deck guns, while increasing the battery capacity and improving the power system, giving it a strong underwater combat capability, the Type 21 has also become the prototype of modern submarines. Incorporating hundreds of classic tactics, and supporting the original tactic system. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea also restores hundreds of classic sea battle tactics and sea battle maps. The players may replay the “Wolf pack tactics”, “Competing for T head” and other famous tactics at real time, and independently design the new tactics based on the maps, natural environment, weather conditions, warship combination and other objective factors. Diversified competition modes, and team play varying from modes. The actual sea warfare is not merely the exchange of firepower. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea provides tens of combat modes, from the MOBA random matching for combat, the battle to seize the isle for testing the team tactics, to the short distance contact battle without isle, combat of small teams in different sizes, and even the super large legion PVP battlefield in the boundless water…, available to meet the different requirements of game players. Each mode includes several sets of applicable tactics and derivative skills, bringing the endless and changeable battlefield experience. Manual setting of multiple gun positions on the whole ship. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea adopts the manual control setting of the whole ship's gun positions, which can manually control multiple firepower points. Even in cruise mode, it can control the firepower from any angle and switch different attacking equipment, fully enjoying the real 'competitive competition, control' pleasure'. No island and all waters battlefield. For the first time, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea has added an island-free mode to the 3DTPS vehicle naval battle online game, simulating a real sea encounter situation, greatly improving the mobility of combat units, creating an unfettered battlefield in the entire waters, and avoiding the embarrassing situation of 'all people squatting'. Various lighting and striking methods. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea uses the water surface inertial simulation system to create real ballistics and ship inertial displacement, which greatly increases the cost of attacking moving targets. Only by constantly moving and changing the travel path during the battle can the player escape the fierce artillery fire and become the last king! Highly immersive interactive map to restore World War II scenarios. The development team of Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea accurately simulates the isles, reefs, buildings, metrological, weather conditions, etc. of many sea areas in the world, based on the results of consulting extensive historic records and many times of site surveys, and the actual geographic environment data. Separated Damage Calculation system to ensure more accurate attack. In addition to the original damage calculation by health bars of the TPS vehicle war games, Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea is incorporated with the separated damage calculation system (“SDC”). Commanded by hundreds of officers of World War II, providing warships with tactic soul. Steel Ocean: Wolves of Deep Sea includes the innovative warship commander system, incorporated with hundreds of famous navy generals during the 2nd World War, based on the actual history of the period, to impart the cold warships with the different tactic features. Unique legion system to create super marine legions. The fleet guild system provides a big platform for players to communicate on tactics, and also combines the team play and the fleet growth mechanism into one. Built-in radio voice to effectively restore maritime communication. One of the most critical factors deciding the success or failure of a military operation is intelligence. The information communication at any place and at any time is the basis for the battle with the team collaboration, and the key for realizing the strategic cooperation of multiple warship types in the modern sea battles.
row.short_description: It is a free-to-play shooting game.You may choose 6 types of warships used in the WWII to play PvP and PvE naval battle. Start the voyage with your warships and fight for the honor of your fleet!

row.name: Welcome, Get Out!
row.detailed_description: ' Welcome, Get Out! ' is a puzzle game where the cranky narrator really doesn't like you being there. It is a Point&Click comedy adventure that will take you through 7 different hand-crafted levels against the wishes of the sarcastic narrator who is trying to stop you from succeeding. As you play, you'll click, drag, and tap your way through a variety of puzzles. The narrator will be discouraging, but if you listen closely, they will tell you how to complete the puzzle. Will you best him? Features A Point&Click adventure. No need for a Keyboard or a Controller! Touch screen support. Your finger is like a mouse, right? Fully 2D graphics bundled with smooth animations. Nearly fully voiced. So you can hear the sarcasm too! A quick game. It can be finished in under an hour. The Levels The Main Menu - You need to start the game somehow too, right? Rock Paper Scissors - Don't break anything. Press The Button - Button Mashing Time! The Box - Unlock it to find a way through. The Clock - Even narrators need to know the time. The Machine - I think it's missing some pieces. The Code - Likely shouldn't touch that. Festivals This project was presented at Columbia College Chicago's Manifest 2021! This project was also presented at Electrify! Esports, Education, Innovation 2021!

It is a Point&Click comedy adventure that will take you through 7 different hand-crafted levels against the wishes of the sarcastic narrator who is trying to stop you from succeeding.

row.name: 8/8/88 Needle AL
row.detailed_description: Old Godfrey returns from his morning walk to find the town eerily deserted. Where did the townsfolk vanish to? And what could have caused such a devastating outcome? Unravel the twisted mystery and uncover the heart-wrenching tragedy that befell this cursed town. Immerse yourself in the stunningly realistic 3D photography of 8/8/88 Needle AL, a game that seamlessly blends the visual-novel and point-and-click adventure genres to create a dark gaming experience unlike any other. With a bone-chilling storyline about a cult, corruption, and racism in the post Civil War south, this game is a must-play for horror fans who loved our previous title 'Wardwell House'.

row.name: Ren's Demons I
row.detailed_description: You . This is a game about you. When you clicked play, did you even wonder what it meant? Did you believe it would only be about saving a dark world from an army of demons? Did you think about games that blew your mind and pushed beyond the boundaries? Did you anticipate the powers that you would gain? Did you assume it was just a game? -------------------------------- Ren is the Promised Child , chosen by the Goddess to save the world from the forces of darkness. But nobody expected that this quest would transcend the boundaries between universes and bring a new understanding of the fabric of reality itself. In this experimental philosophical narrative RPG you will find A non-linear universe full of optional content for you to explore A quirky narrative battle system A minimalist atypical colorful art style An entirely original cross-platform game engine built for the project Favorite old school RPG features coming back: walk on the world map, name your characters, and more A procedurally generated world different for every player 15 unique characters to invite to your party, more than 74 monsters to encounter 7 different endings Between 5 and 30 hours of content depending on how exploratory you feel -------------------------------- Translation This game engine is written in web technologies. You can launch the game in your own web browser using the index.html file in the game folder. When you do that, you can use your browser translation to play the game in any language. However, the experience will be very impaired (there are wordplays, riddles, and other non translatable quirks...).
row.short_description: Did you think this game was only about saving the world from an army of demons? No. This is a game about YOU. On the surface, it may be a new form of innovative experimental philosophical narrative RPG, but its deeper secrets could make you a god.

row.name: Collapsed
row.detailed_description: Using your intuitive understanding of physics, challenge yourself to complete each of the 50 levels and bring about a collapse in this puzzle and logic game. Select from three different types of cannonballs - normal, polished, or fire. Normal: just a heavy piece of metal to lob at fortresses. Polished: launches at high velocity - perfect for taking out stubborn targets. Fireball: does exactly what you expect - sets wood on fire! Each level contains structures made from a wide variety of individual pieces. Collapse houses, castles, and more with a varied selection of levels and components. Once every piece has been destroyed or has fallen to the ground, the level is completed. The more cannonballs you have remaining at the end of each level, the higher you will score!
row.short_description: Challenge your mind with a 3D physics-based puzzle game. Take control of a cannon and use your limited supply of cannonballs to bring each level crashing to the ground. row.name: J-Jump Arena
row.detailed_description: Jump, Predict, Outsmart! All moves happen at once in this fast-paced, free-to-play turn-based game! It’s like Rock, Paper, Scissors… on steroids! In J-Jump Arena, you’ll plan your moves, then watch the madness unfold as everyone acts at once.  Chaos guaranteed. Carefully predict your opponents’ actions and outmaneuver them to stay in the game. Let's be real, though... You’ll probably blow yourself up, but that’s half the fun. Various Game Modes to Keep You on Your Toes Get ready for a wild ride with a range of game modes! Fight to be the last one standing in chaotic Last Man Standing , or dominate the battlefield with the most kills in Deathmatch . Prove who's boss in intense 1 vs 1 Duels , and keep on your toes in Disappearing Platforms , where the floor vanishes under your feet. Race to victory while blasting foes in Weapon Race . And if you're all about showing off your jumping skills, Treasure Hunt 's got you covered - out-jump your rivals and snatch up the most gems! Unleash Mayhem with a Wild Arsenal Wreak havoc with over 20 weapons , each more chaotic than the last! Get inventive with the Quacknator 9001 , a rubber duck that either explodes or hilariously swells up after each turn. Or freeze your enemies in their tracks with the icy Frostcore . And if you truly despise someone, nothing says revenge quite like hurling a Jar of Mosquitos right at ’em. Prefer to go old-school? The Revolver , Grenade , and Bazooka are all locked and loaded, ready to bring the destruction. Whether you're tactical or trigger-happy, there's a weapon for every style of chaos! Explore Diverse Environments From treacherous Swamps to the fiery pits of Hell , each map brings its own dangers and chaos. Want to challenge gravity? Take your fight to the low-gravity madness on the Moon ! Or crawl through the ashes of civilization in the Postapocalypse arenas, where radiation is your new best mate. With even more unique locations, every arena forces you to adapt, improvise, or get left behind in the dust. Rich Customization Unlock ridiculous gear and cosmetic nonsense to make your fighter stand out... or stand out for all the wrong reasons. Either way, you’ll look glorious doing it. Features: Simple, easy-to-learn mechanics. Multiplayer mayhem with up to 10 players. Solo mode with bots for practice or casual play. Multiple game modes to keep things fresh. Unlock items and customize your character. Earn Steam Achievements to show off your skills. Think you’ve got the brains to survive the chaos? Prove it, sunshine.
row.short_description: J-Jump Arena is a free-to-play, turn-based elimination party game, in which you'll probably blow yourself up - but still have a good time doing it! Think you’ve got the brains to survive the chaos?

Romp of Dump
row.detailed_description: Wouldn't you like to play with dangerous prisoners, make them suffer defeat and humiliation, and have your heart broken by their darkness? 'Romp of Dump' is the perfect game for women who want to enjoy such immorality. Players, as death row inmates falsely accused of being serial killers, attempt to communicate with abnormal criminal prisoners through 'betting cards'. A 'penalty game' for losers! 　Beat the dangerous prisoners, dent their pride, and collect the episodes told in the Penalty Game to unravel the bizarre crimes they committed. This is a bromance visual novel that offers the immoral experience of a public execution. The saved data from the demo version can be carried over to the full version. It includes four casino-style mini-games, including 'Blackjack,' and a visual novel tailored to short stories. The ability to recognize small gestures and changes in facial expressions and dialogue of unique characters determines the winner, allowing players to enjoy playing games against the CPU. Streamers can get excited by predicting the score with their viewers! Live2D animated standing drawings with a high range of motion animate a variety of facial expressions and gestures to color the conversational drama. The total number of motions for all characters is more than 200, and each character has more than 100 different facial expressions! The scenario is a massive volume of over 200,000 words in all. It can be played casually or in depth by collecting numerous branches and delving deeply into the world. The main scenario is a suspense story about a bizarre crime. Gathering information and hypotheses about the case and unraveling the truth with your own hands, the development is sure to be exciting as you anticipate the true story! 【Live Game Streaming and Fan Art Guidelines】 'Romp of Dump' welcomes game distribution and fan art! I welcome both individuals and corporations to distribute and monetize their work without permission. There are no restrictions on spoilers, and you can distribute up to the end of the story. When submitting videos, please include the name of the game and a link to the official website or Steam store page. When submitting fan art, we would appreciate it if you could clearly state the name of the work and use the hashtag #RompOfDump 【Story】 1992, Dumpir, a city of pleasure and immorality. When this place, threatened by the shadow of a serial killer, was still called paradise.... The Dumpir Prison, called the 'Dump,' is a cesspool where those who misbehave in the city at night are thrown in. There was a bored death row prisoner there… Hi, I'm 'As K. Nightmare'. You can call me 'K-Nnight' if you like. I'm not comfortable with the idea of sitting back and waiting to be executed for a crime I didn't commit, so I'm thinking of playing cards with all the prisoners. The loser gets a penalty game...well, let me tell you a funny story. Like what crime they came to this prison for...? The key to winning is to recognize the quirks of characters animated in Live2D. Play with the scum prisoners in a new type of card game. 【CHARACTER】 As K. Nightmare Well, I'm a guy who has XXX with everyone... but I don't remember having XXX with any goddess of the law, okay? Charges: Serial murder and XXXX Sentence: Death penalty The protagonist of this story. He was falsely convicted and sentenced to death. He is a man with a dangerous charm that captivates people. Louq＝Goodman Oh, uh, you know. I'm Lou, Lou... Louq. Ah! 'Louq', not 'Looouq'...! Charges: murder, abandonment of a corpse Sentence: 2 years and 6 months An exemplary person to be bullied. He seems harmless by all accounts. He is a '37 year old kid' who acts healthy despite his difficulties in life. Faye My name is Master Faye!　I'm the worst, worst, worst hitman of ACIDD, the Tamayuran Mafia, remember that! Charges: murder, aggravated assault Sentence: 70 years Despite his neutral appearance, he is a troublemaker with a constant stream of extreme words and actions. His empty head is filled with murderous intent and cruelty. Durum De Milo We are what the guards call us by number. We are each other's cesspool trash and need no further relationship. Charges: bodily injury, confinement Sentence: 22 years A taciturn loner who hates to get along with others. He appears to be a sensible man, but his words and actions reveal a deep darkness. Franbel Ripstein I followed my beliefs and did the right thing. That's the decisive difference between me and you scum... Charges: Damage to dead body Sentence: 3 years of imprisonment He is calm, proud and fastidious. He was an excellent doctor before his arrest and despises other prisoners as 'Lowlife'. Drake O Mojita Well, you can lick it all you want. Someday I'll make you understand that it's a terrible poison... Charges: Drug trafficking, murder Sentence: 25 years in prison He is a drug dealer known as 'Little Draco'. He is a charlatan who loves money, but is also rumored to be ruthless and sharp.
row.short_description: Visual novel fully animated in Live2D, Observing Scum Prisoners! In a prison called a dump, a betting card game among dangerous prisoners begins. Penalty game for the losers! Uncover the hidden pasts and bizarre crimes of these lunatics!
row.notes: This game contains bizarre crimes, drugs, prostitution and its facilitation, bullying, child abuse, sexual expressions, various sexual orientations and perversions including homosexuality, and disregard for the feelings of the bereaved family, and Inappropriate remarks. These expressions do not include direct depictions and are not intended to affirm or promote discrimination, prejudice, or crime. If you are under 15 years of age or if you are offended or traumatized by any of the above elements, please do not play this game.

row.name: Fish 'N' Chips

Take up the challenge, swing through the levels, and save your friend! But be aware, a single fall can lead a long way back! Fish 'N' Chips is a quick adventure game. The controls are very simple. Your friend is waiting for you!

row.name: Time Thief
row.detailed_description: Time Thief is a short, simple game made with the PICO8 fantasy console. You can expect around 1 hour of play time. If you leave your village, the clock starts ticking. You only have 60 seconds to live. Explore the top-down map and use your sword to steal time from other living creatures in the world while you search for the 3 Time Keys that are scattered throughout the map. Solve puzzles, navigate dark caves and fight multiple enemies before facing one final challenge. What's on the other side of the Time Gate? Where will you find the three Time Keys?
row.short_description: Time Thief is an action adventure game where leaving your village makes the clock tick. Manage your time to stay alive, stealing seconds from creatures around its overworld with your sword.

row.name: Programming Without Coding Technology 2.0
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the second generation of the Programming Without Coding Technology (PWCT) software. A novice programmer can use PWCT as a tool to apply programming concepts and develop applications and 2D games. This is a free open-source software (MIT License) powered by the new Ring programming language and provide professional Ring developers with a powerful and productive self-hosting visual programming language. Features: Visual Programming using Goal Designer (Steps Editor) instead of Code Editor Form Designer to design the application user interface (WYSIWYG) Rich comments (Add images, tables, etc.) to the application design The Time Machine to play programs as movie and run programs in the past Autocomplete Interactive Visualization from textual source code Customization (Colors & Environment Options) Different styles and themes Develop Apps for Drawing & Simulation Develop Card Games Develop desktop applications for Windows, Linux and macOS Develop 2D Games Create classic/retro games with tile maps (Support Tilengine) Develop Web applications Comes with many samples and applications Open many visual source files at the same time Open many interaction pages at the same time Support generating and importing the textual source code Connect to any database using ODBC Native support for SQLite, MySQL & PostgreSQL Support many game programming libraries Support 3D graphics programming
row.short_description: Apply programming concepts to develop applications and 2D games through visual programming and interactive visualization. PWCT2 is a free, open-source self-hosting visual programming language built with the Ring programming language, and it supports both importing and exporting Ring code.

row.name: Project Nautilus
row.detailed_description: Features of this Game Immersive Drone HUD Expansive World Narrative Rich Immersion Hello Drone Operator #4861! Hello, and welcome to the Isthmus Corporation Family. My name is PASSION and I will be your managerial AI, and I will help oversee your work. We would like to remind you everything that you are seeing is confidential and would like to remind you of the NDA you signed at this time. Now let us begin what is Project Nautilus. What to expect Project Nautilus is a first-person underwater exploration game where you, a menial drone operator, navigate through the depths as directed by your employer, the shady mega-corporation, Isthmus Corp. As Isthmus Corporation lays claim to a previously undiscovered cave system deep below the surface, you are assigned to survey the hidden caverns and uncover their secrets. You are entrusted to expand the company’s wireless network with the placing of signal beacons as you explore. Your “trusty” managerial AI, PASSION, guides you to use your drone harpoon and drill to break open pieces of the environment and propel yourself further down into the depths below. As you explore the rich, biodiverse cave network you begin to discover remnants of a lost civilization and cultural artifacts including sculptures, etchings, and even old architecture. However, you must remember your one goal from Isthmus Corp., reach the bottom of this cave system and see what lies below.
row.short_description: A first person exploration game set in the not so distant future. Remote operate a drone to explore this newly discovered cave system. Use tools to break away obstacles and propel your way down to find what lies below these long forgotten caves.

row.short_description: Destoria: The Withering is a mini top down shooter game with a sole objective to survive as many waves as possible.

row.name: Porcupine's Fate
row.detailed_description: Porcupine's Fate is an atmospheric first-person sci-fi horror shooter with puzzles, mysteries, and melancholic undertones. This is Chapter 1 in a six-chapter game. One day, every employee of Marsh Industries seemingly vanished. Unable to penetrate the state-of-the-art security system, police have asked The Agency for help. You're called in on a one-man mission to rescue any survivors, neutralize any threats, and retrieve the experimental AI brain Marsh has developed. What happened to the employees? Who is responsible? And what madness has this company created? Find tools and solve puzzles to advance further into the labyrinthian laboratory. - You were sent in with a gun and a flashlight. That won't nearly be enough equipment to combat the dangers you'll be facing. Not even close. - Thankfully, this lab is well-stocked with everything an intrepid adventurer needs to stay healthy and continue breathing, including a crowbar, a spray bottle and a screwdriver. Better pick up everything you can carry! - Unfortunately, all of these things and more are required to find your way through the locked and occasionally booby-trapped maze of doors and corridors that make up the Marsh building. Read the notes of survivors, the last emails sent before the disaster, and the bizarre bloody messages smeared across the walls. - Check the computers in case the emails sent on that fateful day hold a clue. And maybe you'll find schematics for the AI brain you were sent to retrieve. - Discover the terrible fate of those waiting to be rescued. Are any still alive? Will you find and rescue them or only find heartbreak? - And what to make of the messages written in blood. Why would anyone choose to communicate this way and what exactly are they communicating? Do you have the knowledge, quick wits and fast reflexes to navigate the horrors awaiting you in this high-tech nightmare? - It won't be enough to simple figure out the solution to a problem. You might need to rely on your extensive education to find the answer. - But even that might not be enough. As an agent you have sharpened your wit into a deadly weapon and you'll need to access it quickly in order to survive. - The dangers lurk around every corner and they are both visible and hidden. A twitchy trigger finger and a solid grasp of your abilities will be key. Or will you lose your mind venturing through the darkened, blood-soaked corridors, and take your anger out on every destructible object around you? - There WILL be times when you won't know what to do and you'll feel the walls closing in on you making the hairs stand up on the back of your neck. - Will you keep a level head and a calm composure when under this immense pressure? Or will you let off steam in an orgy of violent destruction? - Thankfully, there are plenty of every day objects littering this hellscape that are just waiting to be smashed, bashed and demolished. But better not make too much noise. They WILL hear you and they WILL find you, there in the dark, behind that door, hiding in the shadows. - Destruction might make you feel better but it could also make you feel deader. As in, like a doorknob (which you probably broke off with your crowbar). - They can hear the noises you make and it'll draw them to you like moths to a flame. That is, if moths could stab you, shoot laser beams or electrocute you. - Even the darkness is no cover. They have infrared eyes. Your only hope is to find a hiding place and pray they don't see you. And stay quiet. Will you survive? Or will you discover the only path takes you deeper and deeper into the realm of robotic insanity?
row.short_description: Porcupine's Fate is an atmospheric first-person sci-fi horror shooter with puzzles, mysteries, and melancholic undertones. This is Chapter 1 in a six-chapter game.
row.notes: This game contains gory visuals (of violent acts committed offscreen), suicide and, in later chapters, non-explicit animal death.

row.name: The Aquatic Messenger
row.detailed_description: AN IMMERSIVE ARTS/SCIENCE VIRTUAL REALITY WORLD! Explore microscopic messengers of time inspired by micropaleontology and plankton research! What if there were creatures on earth that were relatively unknown, yet responsible for all the fresh water on the planet? Can ancient forms of plankton from over 10,000 years ago help us understand the future of freshwater ecology? Sound like a scifi movie? Actually, these are the realities of real world plankton! DISCOVER AND LEARN ABOUT VARIOUS SPECIES THROUGHOUT TIME! 490 million years ago when the sea covered the lake with regional stromatolites from cyanobacterial mats 350 million years ago, “the age of fishes”, as revealed geologically in the Helderbergs 20,000 years ago when the Wisconsin ice sheet retreats, revealing hidden life including the Cohoes Mastodon, Ostracodes, Diatoms and Testate Amoebae Native inhabitants, Impacts of settlement in 1850’s, salt in the 1970’s Current times with the instruments and data of the Jefferson Project sensor web, the Fund for Lake George and others helping to keep the lake clean GLIMPSE INTO A FUTURE CREATED BY YOUR ACTIONS What choices in the way we live today will directly impact the future: what will the lake look like in the years 2060 and 2100?

row.name: LandPort
row.detailed_description: We stand in an era of transformation, from the Industrial Revolution to the ongoing Intelligent Revolution, where each leap in technology has profoundly influenced the trajectory of human society's development. As graduates of Art and Technology, we aim not only to showcase our design achievements but also to convey our profound understanding and unique perspectives on this era. The theme of our graduation exhibition, 'Facing the Future, Creating the Future,' is a response to the current Intelligent Revolution. The exhibition is divided into three major sections: Art and Intelligent Technology, Art and System Technology, Art and Display Technology. Through these sections, we delve into intelligent principles, material elements, and interactive experiences in the digital information realm, guided by artificial intelligence and big data. We conduct in-depth artistic experiments based on 'design humanities' in the field of intelligent and systematic art. Our research goals focus on technological innovations and artistic creativity in intelligence and systems, encompassing areas such as intelligent services, system design, and digital information practices, paving the way for future integration of art and science. Amid the wave of the Intelligent Revolution, we recognize the significant potential of highway service areas as crucial nodes in intercity transportation. Currently, many service areas face challenges in resource utilization, information integration, and service enhancement. Therefore, we have designed an intelligent management system for highway service areas in the era of the Internet of Things. Centered around intelligent decision-making, optimized management, and enhanced services, this system integrates vast amounts of data to achieve interconnectedness and support rational decisions made by intelligent systems. We have thoroughly studied management needs and designed an Internet of Things digital twin system to promote intelligent management in service areas. Simultaneously, we have also considered traveler needs, optimizing travel processes and creating a more comfortable and convenient consumption environment. A key aspect of this design is the intelligent decision-making module, which aids consumers in making comprehensive and reasonable travel plans during their journey to the service area, effectively balancing the needs of various participants within a complex system. Another focal point is the digital twin console, tailored to the operational needs of the service area, addressing the challenges of managing complex systems. Through this design, we aim to provide a solid foundation for the digital development and AI-driven decision-making of highway service areas, while reducing management costs, improving efficiency, enhancing operational conditions, and offering travelers a superior and convenient service experience. We believe this design will bring more possibilities to the economic development of highway service areas and serve as a platform for graduates of Art and Technology to showcase their talents and contribute to society.
row.short_description: Today, the intelligent revolution is taking place. Release in the field of art and design and industry has become the focus of research in art and technology majors. The theme of the project is 'Creating the future' is a response to the times when the intelligent revolution is taking place.

row.name: K3LVN
row.detailed_description: K3LVN is a sci-fi action platformer where the player is a creature who’s been experimented on and is trying to escape the space station lab where they’re being kept. K3LVN is able to change their state of matter to alter their behavior. The three states usable are the Gel state which is the default bipedal state, the Liquid state which makes K3LVN smaller and grants the ability to climb on certain walls, and the Solid State, which turns K3LVN into a ball to roll around and gain momentum. They must use these abilities in combination with each other to traverse the environment as quickly as possible. K3LVN was developed by RNG Forge, a group of students at Florida Interactive Entertainment Academy (FIEA), over the course of eight months. Key Features: Play as K3LVN and master his ability to change his state of matter Roll around the environment and gain momentum as a icy, solid ball Run and wall jump as a slimy, bipedal experiment Morph to your surrounds, climb walls, and squeeze through tiny gaps as a liquid blob Test your wits in a series of puzzles that require quick thinking and even quicker reflexes Enjoy a somber story about trust and understanding Take in a beautiful art style with wonderfully rendered characters and breath-taking scenery Controllers, Keyboard and Mouse This game is designed to be played by either a controller or mouse and keyboard. The controls for both may be viewed in-game using the options menu. Here is a list of hte controls Spacebar/A - Jump, double jump, and wall-jump WASD/Left Stick - Move forwards, left, backwards, and right Mouse/Right Stick - Pan camera Left Click/Left Trigger - Melt to Liquid State Right Click/Right Trigger - Freeze to Solid State
row.short_description: K3LVN is a sci-fi action platformer where you play as an experiment trying to escape a space station lab where they’re being imprisoned. Through changing their state of matter, they can stick, jump, and roll their way to freedom.

row.name: revere
row.detailed_description: An abandoned chapel. An old generator that won't start. Someone or something else. And not just one of them. The hours here feel like weeks, but you have to endure it. You must find out the truth. About what? Even you don't really remember that well. 'revere' is a found footage survival horror game that takes the point and click mechanics of Five Nights at Freddy's and combines them with puzzles and minigames. With each stage you have a different objective and a new added foe to fight. The one thing that stays the same is that you still have to keep 'them' away. At all costs. The question is, do you have what it takes?
row.short_description: 'revere' is a psychological found footage horror game where every detail matters. Prepare yourself for an experience where your sanity will be condemned.

row.name: Sway
row.detailed_description: Sway is a short bullet hell game modeled after the Touhou series that can be completed in about 15 to 30 minutes. This game was developed by a 2-person team in 4 months as part of a college independent study. Additional shout-out and credit to the folks at Analgesic Productions for allowing us to use sound effects from their game Anodyne ! Also, feel free to join our official discord server (link is on the right). In Sway you play as a nameless girl who has suddenly found herself in a surreal and hostile world. With no other option, you must press forward through an onslaught of bullets in hopes of finding a way back home. This game features over 45 beautifully-drawn backgrounds paired with 4 original piano compositions. You'll fight 23 unique enemy types and face-off against 5 challenging bosses. Gameplay is simple! Use the ARROW KEYS to move. Hold Z to continuously fire bullets at your foes. Hold SHIFT to reduce your speed and narrow your cone of fire. Press X to use a bomb and clear the screen of enemy bullets. Gather power tokens from fallen enemies to gain additional firepower. Defeated enemies also drop faith tokens which increase your score. Hearts grant you an additional life, allowing you to take more hits before dying. Stars increase your bomb count by 1. That's really all there is to it. We hope you enjoy our first published game and we also hope to bring you even higher quality work in the future!
row.short_description: A short experimental bullet hell. Traverse a dubious reality. Talk to manifestations of your own insecurities. Avoid bullets like you avoid your real-life problems.

row.name: Biomisland
row.detailed_description: Biomisland is a relaxing minimalist nature builder game where your will restores nature using diverse plants at your disposal. You can play this game at your pace and unlock new biomes and plants to create the environment of your dream. The game has been solo-developed as a side project by an enthusiastic programmer during about 2 years. It doesn't have the intention of being an AAA game. It just wants you to relax and have a good time shaping beautiful islands. In Biomisland, your goal is to replenish the island nature by placing trees available in your inventory. Every time you place a new tree, you will receive points according to the numbers of blocks converted to the new biome. When placing trees next to each other, you can increase the land value of the terrain, the higher the value the more range your tree will have. Once you reach the current goal, you get to choose between two new biomes and you will receive new trees according to your choice. Use those new trees to get new points and continue your task. When most of the island is covered, you can access to the next island while keeping your current score and continue your adventure! The game feature fully seed-based randomly generated islands. The cube-shaped islands come into three sizes (small, medium and large), and layout can vary a lot depending on the seed offering infinite possibilities. Islands are always created empty and it's your task to fill it as you wish using your imagination. The game currently feature a total of 30 plants being part of 3 biomes: Forest biome Desert biome Tundra biome Regularly during the game, you will be given the choice between multiple biomes to pick from. Use this decision wisely to receive the plants you need to create beautiful islands. In this game there is no pressure, no time limits, no building restrictions so take your time to enjoy your creation as your building it.
row.short_description: BIOmISLAND is a relaxing minimalist nature builder game. Visit randomly generated islands and restore nature at your own pace using diverse plants at your disposal.

row.name: Argentum Online
row.detailed_description: Argentum Online: An Epic 2D MMORPG Adventure Argentum Online is a captivating 2D MMORPG that transports players to a vast, open-world fantasy realm filled with endless possibilities. With its roots firmly planted in the traditions of classic online role-playing games, Argentum Online stands out by offering a richly detailed universe designed for both the solo adventurer and teams of allies. Main Features: - Epic Quests and Adventures: Embark on hundreds of quests, each telling a piece of the world's vast lore and history. From saving villages from marauding monsters to uncovering ancient secrets, there's always a new challenge. - Dungeon Delving: Explore deep, treacherous dungeons full of fierce creatures and valuable loot. Team up with friends or brave these dangers solo. - PvP Combat: Engage in intense player vs. player combat. Fight for honor, glory, or just the thrill of battle in various PvP formats. - Community and Economy: Join a community where your actions impact the world. Trade, negotiate, and compete in a player-driven economy that adds a layer of strategy to the game. - Customization: Create and customize your character with a variety of skills, attributes, and gear. Tailor your hero to your playstyle, whether you're a front-line warrior or a cunning mage. - Open-World Exploration: Discover a world teeming with life, from bustling cities to remote wilderness. Experience dynamic events and uncover hidden treasures and secrets. Argentum Online offers a blend of nostalgia for MMORPG veterans and accessibility for newcomers. With its emphasis on community, exploration, and player-driven content, it's a game where every player can carve out their own legacy. Join now and become part of the legend! Dive into Argentum Online and start your adventure today!
row.short_description: Argentum Online, a 2D MMORPG, offers epic quests, dungeon delves, and battles in a fantasy world. Emphasizing community, it features alliances, PvP, and a player-driven economy, all within a vibrant open-world setting.
row.reviews: “Argentum Online is an underground and anarchic game. It has no owner; it's the game of the people.” 10 – Pagina 12 “The role-playing game from La Plata that gains followers via the Internet” 9 – El Dia “Argentum, the massive Argentine role-playing game from 1999, returns with a renewed version.” 10 – La Nacion

row.name: Anna VS the A.I.maze
row.detailed_description: This is my first game and it is pretty rough : (. Leaving it up to document my journey but I don't recommend playing it 😭. See more below. The game is a physics-based platforming game in which you escape a virtual maze. Solve some mini puzzles, fight some mechanic-based bosses and perform awesome physics based platforming skills using jumping and grappling. The physics based elements were the primary focus of gameplay, hopefully you will enjoy them The bow is also a big focus, both for grappling and fighting certain enemies. There are some casual platforming elements but mostly a more challenging precision platforming experience. The game was created for a younger relative who is pretty good at platforming which was the inspiration. It also has some timed modes where the player can challenge their skills after completing the campaign with leaderboards. Troubleshooting: The game was created using the Xbox Controller as the primary input device. Testing in this regard is a bit limited but it should work with most controllers as long as they have triggers available. Keyboard and mouse is not supported. The minimum requirements suggest a dedicated GPU and I think that is for the best. The game has been tested on laptops with integrated graphics and it will work at lower resolutions but might not be a very good experience. Although the game itself isn't that graphically intensive, I was trying to learn Unity's overlay camera system combined with Post Processing on each overlay, it does push the GPU fairly hard. Testing in general has been somewhat limited due to the available devices available at the time. SteamDeck performance is pretty solid from my testing. Thank you
row.short_description: A physics-based platforming game in which you escape a virtual maze. Solve some mini puzzles, fight mechanic-based bosses and perform awesome physics-based platforming skills using jumping and grappling.

Regional maps based on real city textures and satellite images; multiple types of transportation and minimalist art design.
