The game features: -Day/Dusk/Night cycle, -Random weather (from clear sky to heavy blizzard), -Software raytracing (not hardware, it will work on both AMD and non RTX cards) with very good performance and quality, -Different obstacles, different handling based on surface and much more. -Live leaderboards! The score multiplier is based on difficulty level. The higher the difficulty, the higher the score multiplier. *The game in currently in late beta and as such it is mostly feature complete** and more or less bug free. However, if you find any annoying bug(s) please let me know either on the forum or on discord ( ) and I will have them fixed very fast. **What will probably be added in the near future is different map types.
row.short_description: Experience the frigid and relaxing atmosphere of Ski3 in this 3D rendition of a 90's classic. Ski down the unending alps and collect point by skiing over flags, but beware for you're not alone in these mountains.

row.name: Iron Jaw
row.detailed_description: Iron Jaw is a roguelike videogame where the player operates a mecha/tank to obliterate all of the bugs around him, become stronger along the map until you kill all the final bosses. You can modify your mecha/tank with a huge amount of different weapons and choose one out of five different avaliable pilots.
row.short_description: Choose one out of five avaliable mechas, pick your weapons and enter in Bulian to wipe out all the bugs you find in your path. How long can you survive?
row.notes: Blood and combat.

row.name: Ballads at Midnight
row.detailed_description: When a sarcastic bard is arrested and exiled to an abandoned castle, she expected to be at the mercy of a hungry, blood-thirsty vampire. She soon discovers that the vampire, Lucius, is not starving: he is gravely bored. She may just survive on borrowed time, one ballad each midnight. (The name can be changed) A well-traveled and gifted bard. Abigail is quick-witted and quick to act, though not necessarily in that order. Sarcasm coats her words like calluses, formed through years of undergoing difficult journeys and indulging difficult people. While she has a strong sense of insight and genuine interest in others, she has a dogged impulse of announcing her observations. This is seldom appreciated, and at worst has led to face grave consequences. Still, no one can deny that she has a flair and talent for entertainment. Not even a centuries-old vampire. (Love interest) One's first impression of Lucius is that he's menacing at worst, and witheringly unyielding at best. However, his coarse exterior is a thin veil for his impressively dry wit - which he's more than happy to reveal if he thinks his sense of humor will be heard. It's rather hard to share one's wit when your guests generally scream and run at the sight of you though. ♦ Enemies to lovers, found family, bonding through shared trauma, and even more of your favorite relationship tropes! ♦ A dark fantasy romance that seamlessly blends lighthearted moments and hidden depths, with believable dialogue and an abundance of banter. (Boy, they love to argue. ;p ) ♦ Beautiful sprite and original music ♦ Three clearly-marked endings - abandon him as early as possible, remain in eternal bliss or discover gruesome secrets about the world around you. ♦ Flavor line choices: be an unabashed flirt or have a razor sharp tongue. The choice is yours, no consequences. ♦ More than 42 000 words (around 3-4h per playthrough) ♦ Partial voice acting & two original bard songs! Ballads at Midnight is rated T for suggestive material, strong language, alcohol use, and allusions to trauma, child abuse, and fantasy violence. Ayael (Director, UI designer & programmer, scripter) - Arrapso (Sprite, background artist), Wudgeous (Lead writer, narrative designer), Notafish (Writer), Jeneara (Editor), Rowanty (scripter), Eliana Zebro (Audio & voice director), Shar Joyner (composer), Megan Youmans (Voice actor - MC), Eric Navarro (Voice actor - Lucius), Kimi (Trailer creator) This visual novel was created in one month during the NaNoReNo 2022 jam.
row.short_description: When a sarcastic bard is arrested and exiled to an abandoned castle, she expected to be at the mercy of a hungry, blood-thirsty vampire. She soon discovers that the vampire, Lucius, is not starving: he is gravely bored. She may just survive on borrowed time, one ballad each midnight.

row.name: Life on the Edge
row.detailed_description: Life on the Edge is an educational tower defense game. You play as a cell that struggles to survive when attacked by various pathogens. Fortify your cell’s defenses to survive the onslaught and changing environmental conditions while maintaining balance (homeostasis). Fight through five levels to face off against the ultimate boss—the COVID-19 virus! Key Features STRATEGIZE AND DEFEND Protect your cell against pathogens by placing key towers in strategic locations. SURVIVE THE ONSLAUGHT Defeat a variety of enemies and even face off against the COVID-19 virus. LEARN AS YOU PLAY Learn and reinforce introductory concepts in cellular biology and immunology concepts. Discover how a cell defends itself from viruses and bacteria and survives using interconnected biological systems. DISCOVER YOUR OWN LABORATORY: PLAY AND EXPERIMENT Experiment in sandbox mode and discover how a cell maintains homeostasis, adapts to environmental changes, and defends itself from pathogen attacks. Learn about various cell structures, receptors, pathogens bacteria, and more with the built-in encyclopedia.
row.short_description: Life on the Edge is an educational tower defense game. You play as a cell struggling to survive waves of bacteria and the COVID-19 virus. Protect your cell and build an understanding of cell biology at the same time!

row.name: Jesus Sacred Heart
row.detailed_description: In this small trivia game, I pretend to make you familiar with four catholic devotions: -Sacred Heart of Jesus -Immaculate Heart of Mary -Chase Heart of Joseph -The Most Holy Rosary The game contains 5 scenes. One with each above devotion, explaining all symbols and other items. The 4th scene will teach you interactively how to pray The Most Holy Rosary. The 5th scene is a trivia game with over 50 questions in where your divine knowledge will be tested Hope you enjoy it, and learn from it! “‘“The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you; the Lord turn his face toward you and give you peace.”’ Matthew 10:33 But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven. /
row.short_description: But whosoever shall deny me before men, him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven. JESUS. Matthew 10:33

row.name: Trash Patrol - Academic Version
row.detailed_description: Trash Patrol is a cooperative multiplayer game for 2-4 players. You and one or more of your friends break into a house. Your goal: Steal every item within the given time! But be aware of the homeowner! They do not condone raccoons running around their house and trashing it! If they spot you: Run! This is not a dirty Job! Raccoons want everything clean. You don't want any dirty goods, do you? That's why all items need to be washed and dried carefully. Afterward, throw them in your teleporting trashcan. Why the trashcan is teleporting around? We have no clue what you did to it! Also, watch out for the dirty hands of the humans. Don’t let them touch your precious trash! Cooperation is Key Do you want to snatch the toaster from the shelf? Or the gnome from the desk? And you can’t reach the items? Grab a teammate and throw them in the air! Higher spots can only be reached together. Whether you are collecting items, washing them, or baiting the human - only teamwork makes the dream work! You outsmart every human and return the stolen goods to those who deserve them: You! Master project at the Salzburg University of Applied Sciences This game is the result of our 2-year project for our master’s degree at the Salzburg University of Applied Sciences. Designed and developed by Hannah Flattinger, Jan Mikusch, Tran Khiet Van Ho, Jeannette Schwalm, Marcell Tóth, Kerstin Hofer. Also, we had some help with our Music and SFX from Lukas Schönwiese.
row.short_description: Trash Patrol is a local cooperative multiplayer game for 2-4 players. Break into a house, look for something to steal together with your raccoon friends. Don’t forget to wash and dry all items carefully! And watch out for the homeowner - They are not amused to see you within their home

row.name: Formula Bwoah: Online Multiplayer Racing
row.detailed_description: Drive, not just manage Decide your racing style and see if you have what it takes to come out on top. Free to play Online Racing is fun when you have loads of players to race against. That is why we are making the game Free to play and Cross Platform. Cross Progression and Cross Platform Formula Bwoah is available on Steam, iOS and Android. You can compete with users across different devices and seamlessly sync your progression across all your devices. Strategy Matters Make strategic decisions that can impact your victory, such as choosing the perfect tire compound and changing your engine modes. Dynamic Weather System Timing your pit stops just right and anticipating changing weather conditions can be the difference between winning and losing. Online Competition Compete with 10 other skilled drivers and see if you have what it takes to emerge victorious.
row.short_description: Formula Bwoah is a free-to-play, cross platform racing game with pit stops, engine modes and changing weather. Download now to experience a game that rewards skillful play and risk taking in online multiplayer.

row.name: Automaton Kingdom
row.detailed_description: Automaton Kingdom is a 2D Autochess puzzle game . It has two different phases , the edit phase and the play phase . -Gameplay. In the edit phase , different characters can be placed in different areas of the map and you can customize many parameters such as direction to face, inventory, team, etc. You can also interact and edit some game objects directly by clicking on them in this phase. After completing the edit phase , the player can see the resolution of the game as the characters interact on their own with the level and with each other. -Mechanics. The player can interact with different elements on the map to alter the outcome. Some elements allow direct interaction , such as some ladders , the inventory , Characters or the team to which the character belongs. On the other hand, there are the elements with which the player interacts in an indirect way . Either by placing a character in the path of a lever so that it activates it, or giving him an object that allows him to destroy an obstacle. -Items. -Characters. Adventurer: The basic character moves in the selected direction and is able to interact with levers and open doors if he has the key equiped. Knight: Heavy character capable of breaking fragile floors and he can also destroy boxes with the hammer equiped. Backpacker: This character has a larger inventory, and is capable of giving items to other characters. Archer: Equipped with a bow, this character is capable of shooting with items other than arrows. like keys to open locked doors. Assassin: This character cannot carry items but is very effective in combat and has great agility. Smith/Mechanic: This character has the ability to fix certain objects if he has the necessary pieces.
row.short_description: 2D turn-based puzzle game with a medieval setting and two game phases. Allied and enemy characters will behave automatically after setting them up in the edit phase. you can see the outcome of the different iterations of the level in the game phase.

row.name: Battle Teams 2
row.detailed_description: Battle Teams 2 is a fast-paced multiplayer tactical shooter with Asian aesthetics. PvP offers action-packed game modes set in a rigorously balanced competitive gameplay environment. Narrative-driven cooperative PvE gameplay throws you and your friends into wave after wave of merciless adversaries. Fast-paced, Fair PvP Battle Teams 2 is dead set to get your blood pumping, whether you favor classic shooter modes like Battle Royale, Bomb Defusal and Team Deathmatch, Free for All, or innovative gameplay like Big Head Hero and Infected. Immerse yourself in fast-paced PvP showdowns where every second is a matter of life or death. No gameplay advantage can be paid for - the playing field is level from start to finish. Your only salvation is your trigger finger. Thrilling Narratives, Intense Challenges Team up with your friends and other players to take on bloodthirsty beasts and unforgiving bosses. Clutch victory from the jaws of defeat with your unique abilities and resources. Upgrade your weapons and carry your team into ever darker realms. Uncover the shrouded truth of an otherworldly realm as the story unfolds through exquisitely crafted cinematics. Battle In Your Way Discover a diverse arsenal of weapons, each with innumerable customization, modification and enhancement options. Tweak your weapons to suit your playstyle and build loadouts to master all battlefields. Every encounter is uniquely yours. Optimized For Any PC Specifications Optimized to run seamlessly on PC's of varying performance capabilities, Battle Teams 2 ensures flexibility and accessibility for everyone. With five distinct graphics settings ranging from very low to very high, the game provides a smooth and enjoyable experience on a wide range of player hardware. Choose the graphics level that best suits your system. row.name: Fearless Rider
row.detailed_description: Join our discord About the Game Goal is simple : drive as fast as you can without hitting any obstacles or falling off the platform. Drive around in a buggy through challenging levels that involves blades, hammers, moving platforms and much more. Avoid hitting obstacles There are blades, hammers, shooting devices, hydraulic press, spinning wooden planks that you should stay away. Wooden planks will throw you away but everything else will kill you. Keep track of time Don't forget the goal. Drive as fast as you can, if you want to. Or else enjoy the journey. But if you want to challenge yourself, then try to finish faster than your current best time. Don't fall off Don't be in such a rush that you fall off the platform and sent back to the last checkpoint. Collect Powerups Powerups like Invincibility, Jump, Speed booster and more are available. Deep, complex role-playing system, inspired by popular paper-and-pencil role playing games. Build the party of adventurers you want, with dozens of skills and powers, and hundreds of spells and items. Try the first chapter 'Danger in Greenvale' for free, which includes a full adventure and conclusion. Continue your adventure by purchasing chapters 2-4.
row.short_description: Epic, classic-style fantasy role-playing game. Single player, party based, featuring real-time with pause gameplay. Combines open-ended exploration with an overall quest. Deep, complex role-playing system, with many skills, powers, spells, and items.

row.name: Slimesventure: Your Destination
row.detailed_description: Slimesventure: Your Destination is a single-player strategy building and adventure game. You can build your own kingdom, gather the resources you need and process them yourself. If the buildings in your own kingdom don't produce enough, you can upgrade them! But before you can build your own kingdom, you need to build a foundation. Make friends with the inhabitants of the neutral town, complete their quests to earn money for a place to sleep, and buy or sell items from various merchants. But keep an eye on the clock, because you won't be able to live unscathed forever - after all, you're apparently a 'criminal'. You only have 100 days, by which time you must be stronger than the enemy. So plan carefully how you travel, trade and build. It was a normal morning when a strong gust of wind blew open the window and a letter from your mother flew in. It was barely legible, half burnt, but you could make out some key points. It said that you should make your way to the king, your brother. You entered the great hall and spoke to your brother, but he did not recognise you, did not consider you his brother, and was angry at your unfriendly way of just walking in. You are chased from your home, but catch a train to the Neutral City. Once there, you discover that you have lost your identity card and that you have no proof of identity. You go to the local authority to apply for a new one. [...]

row.name: Nell Watson's Founder Life
row.detailed_description: ARE YOU READY TO JUMP IN THE ENTREPRENEURIAL DEEP END? Founder Life is a casual, episodic narrative game where you must balance health, wealth and happiness with the demands of being an entrepreneur. Designed by serial entrepreneur, Nell Watson , Founder Life takes you on a journey through early stage entrepreneurship, teaching you how to manage the balance of how you spend your energy, attention, focus and cash. It teaches the discipline required to successfully execute on the early stages of a startup, involving customer discovery, self-knowledge, and effective habits. The game incorporates a side narrative that allows the player to explore many startup quandaries and dilemmas taken from real life experience. Key features: - Casual yet compelling gameplay - Engaging storyline based on real life startup experiences - 5 entrepreneurial episodes - Unlock 'Founderpedia' achievements - hard-earned nuggets of entrepreneurial wisdom - The most playful, entertaining way to learn about entrepreneurial life.

row.name: Cactus Cowboy - Plants at War
row.detailed_description: When the bug army attacked Cacti Island, the Cacti Army deployed you into battle. row.name: ThanksTaking
row.detailed_description: ThanksTaking is a game where you play as an angry turkey, looking for revenge on thanksgiving night.... You have been taken home to be cooked for thanksgiving, and you have to make sure not to let that happen by killing anyone in your way! You need to explore the house and find keys to open the front door and escape before you get cooked. Use a variety of attacks and moves to defend yourself in combat.. You can hide under and behind obstacles to not get noticed by people, however dogs can still smell you if you are hidden. You must complete the level before vicious dogs are released onto you. You can decide to play this game in stealth, or engage in all out bloodshed! Gameplay: -You have to explore a house full of people and dogs trying to catch you -You have to escape the house before angry dogs are released on you and can find you anywhere on the map -You have to collect keys around the house to be able to open the front door and progress to the next level -You can play the game by avoiding enemies and hiding, or go on a rampage -You have a variety of unique abilities and attacks to unlock and help you defeat enemies Cosmetics: -You can unlock skins for your character by just playing the game and gathering currency. These do not affect your stats or in game performance, just cosmetic. -You can unlock Hats and other accessories by opening wishbones. Wishbones are bought with the in game currency Tur-coin. If you grab the correct side of the wishbone, you will be rewarded with a random Hat or accessory. These are also purely cosmetic and serve no real purpose.
row.short_description: Play as a bloodthirsty turkey seeking vengeance on everyone in the household! You must try to escape the house before you are caught and cooked. Use a large variety of brutal attacks to take down your enemies and show them who's boss!
row.notes: Some blood can be seen when something is damaged or killed in game. This is to give the player some feedback for a more engaging gameplay experience.

row.name: Tracing Decay
row.detailed_description: Tracing Decay is an online art museum with multiple galleries featuring artworks from the selected world renown artists: Barbara Graf 's Anatomical Bodies Huda Lutfi's Dreams Daniel Reidy's Collateral Agendas Daniel Reidy featuring Greg Pond in Piano Burial Browse their featured paintings and sculptures in a curated environment that contrasts their work and tells the story that links their work together. Find the hidden videos by the artists, enjoy the art work, and experience it in your own way - find your own story out of it. The selected art works have been scanned and recreated to a photorealistic quality for the work to be enjoyed as if you're standing in front of it in real life. Visit our website for more information on the artists and their work.
row.short_description: Tracing Decay is a dark dystopian simulation, that revisits impactful art that revolves around themes of decay, memory loss and recollection. The experience allows the player to explore the environment freely in search for several galleries within the ruins.

row.name: BIPT
row.detailed_description: Bipt is a single player time attack game. Collect stars and make your way to the finish line. Run the Gauntlet and try to get the fastest time. Your final score is the total time spent in all levels combined with whichever collectables were gathered. Is this game going to revolutionize platforming? no Are there hundreds of hours of late-game content? also no Is it any fun? Well, I had fun making it Features 5 platforming levels to race through Super-jump by crouching first Slide through the finish line for a style bonus A short range teleport so you can go right through those hazards Choose your own colors! You can beat the game in like, less than two minutes, really. Here's a pre-emptive 'Thank You!' in case you decide to give it a try.
row.short_description: BIPT is a single player time attack game with multiple endings. Figure out what to collect, and go for the best time! Bipt can slide, super jump, and teleport. Combine these tools and find the fastest path to the finish.

row.name: Personal Space
row.detailed_description: Personal Space is the only roguelike action RPG all about avoiding others. Your only offense is a solid defense! Equip yourself with a variety of stat upgrades, familiars, and abilities to keep enemies at bay. Dodge your way through dozens of randomly selected room layouts, survive until time runs out in each room to advance through a story mode where you'll (reluctantly) meet some odd and interesting characters. If you're in the mood for a real challenge, test your skills in arcade mode! Clear as many rooms as you can and go for a high score. Features: Unique roguelike dodging gameplay with RPG elements. 100+ randomly selected stages to survive and conquer. Story mode complete with two equally good endings. An incredible soundtrack. An endless arcade mode with 9 extra music tracks not found anywhere else in the game! 6 difficulty settings ranging from 'Normal' to 'What the Hell Are You Doing.' For added accessibility or challenge, you can even set your starting HP. 8 color pallet options to suit your style. A sassy convenience store clerk. All for the price of absolutely nothing and no micro transactions. Have fun!
row.short_description: An anti-social roguelike for the ages. Humans may be social creatures, but you sure as heck aren't! Use a variety of items and abilities to ensure your 'survival' against hoards extroverted people. Be persistent, and keep your distance. No violence required.

In this massive dystopian metropolis, you will embark on a journey to find Golden Boughs with a cast of 12 Sinners. Enjoy a gripping story and the series of events that await. row.name: 雀皇麻雀
row.detailed_description: 『雀皇麻雀』は二次元風麻雀ゲームです。 【無料で遊べる】 　ゲーム内通貨——“銅貨”。ゲーム内対局、ログイン、任務達成、ボーナスなどにより無料で獲得できます。課金しなくても全てのモードで心ゆくまで遊ぶことができます。 【オンライン対局】 　インターネットを通じて全国のプレイヤーと４人麻雀および３人麻雀を楽しむことができます。対局で経験を積み、麻雀の腕をどんどん上げましょう！ 　ゲームモードは“挑戦試合”・“段位戦”・“友人戦”・“CPU戦”があり、自分の好きなモードで遊べます。麻雀の神のようなプレーヤーと切磋琢磨するもよし、友達とオンラインでわいわい楽しむもよし、CPUと対戦して黙々と練習するもよし！ 　気軽に麻雀の腕を磨くなら『雀皇麻雀』がピッタリ！ 【初心者大歓迎】 　詳しくわかりやすいチュートリアルをはじめ、初心者向けの簡単な練習モードや対CPU練習モードを用意しています。ゲーム内には役紹介や打牌ヒントがあるので、完全な初心者が上級者へと華麗に変貌を遂げることもできます！ 【スムーズな操作】 　リアル麻雀を可能な限り再現しているため、スムーズで滑らかな操作感でプレイできます。 【AIデータ分析】 　システムが戦績データなどの基本情報を記録しているので、科学的分析を通じて麻雀技術を向上させることができます。 【多彩なキャラクター】 　個性豊かなキャラクターが登場し、ゲームを通じてキャラクターとの絆を強めることができます。雀士キャラクターとの物語を紡ぎましょう。また、続きが気になるストーリーや雀士とのプライベートメッセージのやり取りも体験できます。 　ストーリーが進むにつれ、雀士キャラクターに隠された秘密も明らかになっていきます。すべてのキャラクターとの仲を深めて、“得失の間”の真相を解き明かしましょう！ 【華麗で立体的なグラフィック】 　全てのキャラクターでLive2Dによる“リアルな動作”を楽しむことができます。ストーリー中の情景を鮮やかに描いたCG画により、没入感と臨場感、そしてギャルゲーのような繊細な感情を味わうことができます。 【自分だけのカスタマイズ】 　トップ画面の壁紙、キャラクターフレーム、麻雀牌、麻雀卓、リーチ棒、キャラクタースキン……そして、多種多様なゲームエフェクト。自分好みにカスタマイズして、最高のデザインを追求しましょう！ 『雀皇麻雀』の主人公はあなた！ “雀皇”の座を目指す旅を始めましょう！ ※ 麻雀の雀皇では、対局中の配牌や山牌等はランダムに行われており、意図的な操作等は一切御座いません。
row.short_description: 無料で気軽に遊べる！初心者も簡単に楽しめる麻雀ゲーム——『雀皇麻雀』。ついにSteamで登場！

row.name: Planetary Planter
row.detailed_description: Planetary Planter is a single-player, open-world, third-person farming game where, instead of farming normal vegetables, you grow celestial bodies while exploring an alien world. You explore the alien world using exploration tools to find seeds and modifiers scattered throughout the environments. After planting and growing planets and stars you can harvest them. Once the planets and stars are harvested, the player can arrange them into solar systems, and arrange those solar systems into constellations. Players completing these constellations results in them receiving new exploration tools to help them explore as well as getting more of the story unlocked to read. Planetary Planter has 10 constellations the player can fill out! Collect 5 unique celestial bodies and 6 modifiers. That totals 35 unique celestial bodies! Watch out for the Squimbus! This dubious little creature will steal your items! This game is perfect to sit back and relax with because there is no way to die! The art and music were made to make the game as relaxing as possible with cute creatures and relaxing music!
row.short_description: Planetary Planter is an open-world farming game where, instead of farming normal plants, you grow celestial bodies while exploring an alien world.

row.name: Slava Ukraini!
row.detailed_description: This is a game. Or rather, it is a tribute to the courage of the people and armed forces of Ukraine. In Slava Ukraini! , the goal is to defend Ukraine from the Russian invasion. You will do this by chosing which battles to fight in order to delay the invasion while receiving support from friendly nations around the world. Over time, you will be given access to more weapons and equipment, while the enemy resolve is weakened by international sanctions and battlefield casualties. The game features a strategic mode and a few different tactical modes, where the strategic mode is played on a full map of Ukraine while the tactical modes (or 'battles') are played in first person, each 'battle' lasting only a few minutes. At release time, the 'battle' scenes of the game will be mainly about ambusing enemy columns and defending fixed positions. These battles are all played in static first person mode. The plan, however, is to keep developing the game, adding features and improving gameplay for as long as needed. More on what's being considered will follow. Slava Ukraini! is completely free-to-play and contains no commercial ads. However, if you would like to support the Ukrainian armed forces, place a donation to the special fund set up by the National Bank of Ukraine. On the future of Slava Ukraini! The initial release of the game will contain mainly very short battles in static first person perspective, meaning that it's like an FPS but the player cannot move, always fighting from a stationary position. This is somewhat adequate for the ambush- and air-defence missions that will be in the initial release. There are plans to add additional gaming modes, including armoured warfare gunnery and more complete FPS features. Some thought is going into adding political features and administration of humanitarian aid for the strategic mode, as well as artillery spotting, intelligence analyzing, cyber warfare components and so on. The base game is fairly modular, so the limit is set by imagination. Player requests for additional game modes will definitely be considered.
row.short_description: A completely free game of heroic defence against enemy aggression. Take part in the defence of Ukraine against Russian aggression. A tribute to the courage and valor of the Ukrainian armed forces.
row.notes: Depictions of war, including scenes resembling actual events.

row.name: Who Run The City: Multiplayer Playtest
Panzer Arena: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Panzer Arena: Prologue is an experimental tank PvP game. Boost, drift and flip your way through any kind of terrain in order to destroy your opponents. Use several types of abilities and weapons and compete in multiple game modes. Movement You control a nimble little tanks that can jump, dash and do all kinds of flips. No terrain is too difficult to conquer and no opponent can escape if you master the movement in Panzer Arena. Combat Currently you have the choice of 4 weapons and a few abilities. You can dash, use a dome, stealth or use an impulse dart that can propel you to even bigger heights. Tanks have the thickest armor up front so you can't just spam your shots, you need to calculate every move and wait for the right moment to strike in the rear of your opponent. Style Switch up your style based on the situation. Is your opponent aggressive? Use a shotgun. Is your opponent shy? Use the charge rifle! Or perhaps it's best to just freestyle and be creative. The invisible skybox is your limit! Game Modes Currently you can play Free for All, Team Deathmatch and Duels. The first two are self-explanatory but the Duels mode needs some explanation. Imagine you've invited your friends over to play video-games but there's only 2 controllers. What do you? Well you play winner stays on. Two players go head to head while the other watch (or taunt) and wait their turn. Winner stays on, loser gets put in the back of the queue. Experimental Please note that this project is highly experimental. I'm developing this on my own so don't expect a ton of updates or content drops. Your feedback is very much appreciated!
row.short_description: Panzer Arena:Prologue is an experimental tank PvP game. Boost, drift and flip your way through any kind of terrain in order to destroy your opponents. Use several types of abilities and weapons and compete in multiple game modes.

row.name: The Lost Dachshund
row.detailed_description: About this game The Lost Dachshund is a quick, relaxing point and click Adventure game where the player must find Peanut, a dachshund puppy who is running amok on peaceful Waldi Island, before the ferry arrives carrying your granddaughter. Meant for casual gamers of all ages who are looking for a small, bite-sized game that can be completed in under an hour. The Lost Dachshund features include: Find items and clues to help solve puzzles that will help you locate Peanut before she gets herself into any more trouble. Photo Surreal locations crafted in Unreal Engine convey a relaxing walk around a quiet island with simple tasks and objectives. Original music score composed by Andres Ciambotti sets the tranquil tone and creates an idyllic atmosphere. Professional voice narration and character work for friendly Postman Pete, who is always around to lend a helping hand. Easy going and accessible gameplay for players of any age looking for a quick and simple diversion. No ads, no paywalls, no in-game purchases. The Lost Dachshund is a 100% free game meant to be shared and enjoyed by animal lovers and casual adventure game fans. Created by an all volunteer group of artists and programmers (and dachshund lovers) in 90 days as a group Discord project.
row.short_description: Your granddaughter is coming over on the ferry from the mainland. You have promised her a puppy for her birthday– a dachshund named “Peanut”. But Peanut has escaped her pen and is free on the island. You must traverse the island and rescue the mischievous puppy, before your granddaughter arrives.

row.name: Sovranti
row.detailed_description: What is Sovranti? Sovranti is an entire board game library that you can play from your PC, tablet or phone. Our rules-enforced gameplay helps folks learn games, keeps track of scoring and gives you the feeling of sitting around a table with friends! Discover our growing catalog of competitive, coop and solo games. Focus on the fun and not spending all your time looking up rules. What's special about Sovranti? Full rules enforcement! No more guessing how to play the game or forgetting rules. Automated scoring for all games. Feels like sitting around the table with friends. If you can play the game on Sovranti you can play it around the table and vice versa. All of our game look and feel just like they would if you are sitting around a table in person. 3D environments. Want to play in a medieval castle or on the moon? Or maybe you would prefer to play in a garden? The choice is yours. Avatars! Part of replicating playing around a table is being able to feel like you are there. Our 3D avatars give you that sense of being there. We have lots more planned for avatars in the future! Voice and text chat built in. Solo play! If the game has solo play we add that as well so you can play even if your group isn't available. Mobile first design with simple controls that work equally well on a phone, tablet or computer. All you need a phone, tablet or PC and an Internet connection and you can play with friends no matter where you are. All games officially licensed so you are supporting the publishers and designers of the games. How does it work? Simply download the app on any available platform, sign up for a free account and start playing! Every month we rotate which games are available to play for free so there's always something free to play. We do offer paid subscriptions that allows you to play any game whenever you want. Start a table and have your friends join or try one of our solo games. What are the subscription levels? Sovranti is free-to-play . No paid subscription is required to play. Our free Silver account grants access to any of the games on the free play list which rotate periodically. Our Gold account unlocks all the games so you can play any game at any time. Our Platinum account unlocks all the games for you and everyone else at the table. We often refer to this as our Family or Game Group subscription as only one person at the table needs this account and everyone else can just have a Silver account and you can play whatever you want. Key features Full Rules Enforcement Automates Scoring Supports 1-8 player games Full voice and text chat built in 3D Environments and Avatars Rotating library of free to play games Cross-platform play between phone, tablet, PC and Mac

Our rules-enforced gameplay helps folks learn games, keeps track of scoring and gives you the feeling of sitting around a table with friends! Discover our growing catalog of competitive, coop and solo games.

Lead the squads to victory with your strategy and your team's brilliance. ■ Beautifully Composed Grandoise BGM Grand yet exquisite BGMs to every situation in the story to enhance the immersion! Why not play CounterSide with unique BGMs?
row.short_description: Everything has another side Urban Graphic Novel RPG 'CounterSide' A world where conflict never ends between Counters and Corrupted Objects after the Administration Failure We invite you to a journey to save the Reality.
row.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages: Veiled Nudity, Sexual Themes, and Fantasy Violence. Characters in the game may appear in revealing outfits during gameplay or cutscenes. However, the game does not contain any depictions of sexual acts, non-consensual sexual content, sexual assault, or drug abuse.

row.name: ShadowBringer
row.detailed_description: Welcome to GEC, new employees! Here at the Genetic Engineering Corps, the future of mankind is created! ShadowBringer is a 3D stealth game set in the retro-futuristic era, where the players take on the role of a lab-created shadow monster. Without recollection of the past, the voice in its head urges the player to discover the truth buried deep within an unknown territory and try to escape from the underground research facility. Light is the bane of your existence, and darkness is your only safe haven. Security guards will be your obstacle to the path of freedom. They are relentless, and they are not afraid to put their lives in line to stop you. Stealth gameplay with various abilities to aid your journey 3 unique levels (The Containment Chamber, The Lab, The Server Room) Retro sci-fi atmosphere Various collectibles that reveal more background of your origin Underpaid and overworked guards that will hunt you down This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Escape the underground research facility and discover the truth of your origin. ShadowBringer is a 3D stealth game where you take on the role of a shadowy monster. Awakened with no recollection of the past, a voice in your head whispers softly to you: 'Get out of this place'.

row.name: A100
row.detailed_description: About This is a collection of five mini-games. Include： Weather Invader： When humans have the ability to modify the weather, you need to completely destroy the unqualified weather. Stronghold Attack： A war between two castles, you need to use magic to destroy all the people on each other. Guard Tank ：Driving a tank to guard the power station, the enemy will attack from all directions in waves. Heavy Artillery： Shoot a duck with a shotgun in your hand, for a duck a shotgun is a cannon. Space Miner： Dodge flying rocks and smash them. Get gold in the rocks. Feature The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.
row.short_description: This is a collection of five mini-games. Include： Weather Invader、 Stronghold Attack、 Guard Tank 、Heavy Artillery、 Space Miner

row.name: Eternal Space
row.detailed_description: Eternal Space Eternal Space is a city management and a space exploration/combat game. Expand your city while you uncover the secrets in space. Manage your city Control your city your way. Keep your citizens happy by constructing Hospitals to keep them healthy and Police Hubs to keep them safe. Collect taxes each year for a little bonus too. Expand your city by constructing buildings and make your citizens happy. Explore Explore the Eternal Space. There is always something new out there. Fight Fight pirates, or become a pirate! Pirates earn a lot of credits, but that also comes at some risk. Freighters Purchase and manage your own Freighter at the cost of 5 milion credits! Craft Tritium-cells to be able to refuel it, jump with it to new locations and do things you never would be able to do without it!
row.short_description: Eternal Space is a city builder and space exploration/combat game. Explore the Eternal Space, and manage your city while you fight pirates, or maybe even become a pirate! Keep your citizens happy, and collect taxes from them each year for a little bonus!

row.name: 木偶公馆
row.detailed_description: 是一款以调查木偶杀人案为目的而展开的2D冒险解谜游戏. 剧情 离奇的案件,隐藏在冠冕堂皇的公馆之下;神秘的梦境,诉说着不为人知的秘密.徘徊在各式各样的线索之间,如穿针引线般记录着事件经过的我们,又是谁. 静坐馆中观其变,忽闻访客拜前堂.恰逢电闪连夜雨,暂躲货屋待天晴. 仔勘细查来回转,死物重生左右摆.待修木偶完成时,水落石出同天明. 小游戏 游戏中充满着各具特色的解谜小游戏,穿插在剧情的必经之路上,等待着玩家前来破解埋藏在其中的信息.
row.short_description: 是一款以调查木偶杀人案为目的而展开的2D冒险解谜游戏.你将扮演一位'足智多谋'的小警官潜入公馆调查案件,挖掘不为人知的真相.

row.name: Abort, Retry, Fail
row.detailed_description: Computers Gods finally grew tired of Larry the programmer's lazy bugs and cheap hacks. That's why they decided to give him the ultimate punishment - send Larry down the computer hell where our hero will have to generate his weapon in order to survive. Gameplay Abort, Retry, Fail is a fun top-down roguelike action in which you shoot your way through nasty electronic enemies in order to escape from computer hell of Windows 98. Key Features: - Classic top-down roguelike - Dungeons in a style of Windows 98 - Familiar enemies from your childhood - Endless weapon combinations - Gamepad support
row.short_description: Abort, Retry, Fail is a top-down roguelike action adventure in which you play as a lazy programmer that has to generate his own weapon and shoot his way through hordes of enemies. Are you brave enough to help him escape from computer hell of Windows 98?
